apps.short_description: Lead your clan through Japan's turbulent Sengoku period. Craft wise strategies to expand your domain and use cunning tactics to defeat your enemies on the battlefield. Emerge victorious, restore order, and claim the title of Shogun!

apps.name: Dokkan!BugBattle
apps.short_description: Enter a 2D battle where unique insects like rhinoceros beetles and stag beetles clash! Land powerful attacks, dodge with quick steps, and unleash special skills across three waves to defeat a mighty boss. Collect bugs through the gacha, raise the difficulty, and beat your Survival Mode record.

apps.name: Don’t  Drop!!
apps.short_description: “Don't Drop!!” is a challenging 3D action game that captures the essence of platformers. Control the ball using only jump commands as you aim for the top of the tower!  Go through repeated trial and error, and experience the thrill of gradually clearing each level!

apps.name: DOOM 3: Phobos
apps.short_description: Waking up on Mars with no memory and a wound you can’t explain, you begin a desperate search for answers - about yourself, your past, and the catastrophe looming over two worlds.

apps.name: Dopamine rogue
apps.short_description:
Manage your dopamine, earn money, build decks, and navigate life's challenges in this psychological life-simulation roguelike. Every choice shapes your story as you struggle to survive your own mind.
A solo-developed project crafted over two years.

apps.name: Double-Life With Busty Thief & Busty Knight
apps.short_description:
Balance your Day and Night lives with TWO busty girls!
Work at Thief's guild at night with Sif, and at the Knight's guild in the day with Cesta!
Manage your actions each day and pursue your desired career... or love life!

apps.name: Drachenquell
apps.short_description:
Willkommen in der Welt von Drachenquell, einem epischen Abenteuer, das dich in eine Ära voller Mythen und Legenden entführt.
Erkunde die weitläufigen Länder von Drachenquell, wo jede Ecke der Karte mit Leben gefüllt ist.

apps.name: Dream Highway
apps.short_description: A rhythm drive beneath alien megastructures. The music builds the road, sets your speed and lights up the sky. Steer to stay on the highway, lift the nose on the beat to catch orbs, and hold through the boosts. More songs, and your own music, are coming in updates.

apps.name: Dreams Of A Visionary
apps.short_description: Dreams Of A Visionary is a first-person exploration adventure set in a mysterious Victorian mansion. Explore richly detailed rooms, solve challenging puzzles, and gradually uncover the hidden secrets of this surreal dream.

apps.name: Drill Girl
apps.short_description: Drill down to climb up! Bounce off candy crystals, chain combos, and outrun the rising syrup to win back the birthday balloons the birds stole.

apps.name: Drones vs Tanks
apps.short_description: Multiplayer Clash of Tanks and FPV Drones. Dive into a thrilling multiplayer showdown where one player controls a tank aiming to reach its destination, while the other pilots an FPV drone tasked with stopping it. Choose your faction, upgrade your vehicles, and compete in fast-paced rounds!

apps.name: Drunken Hog: Dystopian Pub & Brewing Simulator
apps.short_description: Run your own pub in this atmospheric and story-rich job simulator. Featuring a full brewing pipeline, dynamic NPCs, side quests, bar upgrades and expansions, branching dialogue, a freely explorable city, and a deep narrative set in dystopian Napolis City.

apps.name: Dungeon Automata
apps.short_description: Dungeon Automata「Algolemeth」is an "autologic": a JRPG dungeon crawler meets auto battler where you control your party with visual node-based programming. Program your party and conquer dungeons automatically. Master the dungeon through trial and error!

apps.name: Dungeon Dealer
apps.short_description: Heroes bleed. You profit. Send squads into deadly dungeons, crack open chests of glowing loot and sell every find at the perfect moment. Arm your best heroes, conquer it all, then retire rich and start a bigger era in this pixel-art incremental game.

apps.name: Dungeon Idler
apps.short_description: Fight your way through the endless corridors of Dungeon Idler, an idle roguelite dungeon crawler where death is just another step to power! Collect gear, exploit enemy weaknesses, and upgrade your skills to push further with every run. Fight, die, upgrade, repeat!

apps.name: Dungeon Janitor
apps.short_description: Clean up the messy dungeon, collect and recycle resources and find forgotten loot in this active incremental “chore-like”. Dispose of dead bodies, broken artillery and left-over treasure, wipe the bloody floors and slay the remaining monsters to ready the dungeon for its next great battle.

apps.name: Dungeon Nox Exotica
apps.short_description: A retro first-person dungeon RPG with manual exploration, automatic return routes, and battles you can automate or command. Loot, regroup, read your expedition logs, and descend one floor deeper.

apps.name: DungeonBox
apps.short_description: A fantasy party game for up to 8 players, where everyone joins in from their phones. Type what you want to do, vote for the best idea, and roll dice to see if it works!

apps.name: Dungeons of Desolation Remastered
apps.short_description: Descend beneath the rain-soaked town of Desolation in a turn-based, grid-based dungeon crawler remastered from the Xbox Live Indie Games era. Fight monsters, gather loot, build your adventurer, survive the Wheel of Fate, and uncover why the town profits from doomed adventurers.

apps.name: Dunwich Park
apps.short_description: Dunwich Park is a Lovecraftian horror adventure game and visual novel. Play as the newest park ranger of Dunwich Park, a campground infested with eldritch abominations. With a branching narrative that responds to your choices, actions can have terrible consequences. Choose carefully, choose fast.

apps.name: Eastwynne
apps.short_description: A narrative-focused CRPG set in the grandiose city of Eastwynne, where magic is commonplace. It's 2021, and the start of a new college year. Follow the stories of a group of magical university students; how will your choices alter their lives?

apps.name: Ecumene Aztec
apps.short_description: Ecumene Aztec is a brutal action-adventure game with stealth elements, set in the time of the Aztecs. Take on the role of a fugitive who has escaped being sacrificed. Fight, climb and survive in a dark and bloody world. Decide which side of the conflict you will take...

apps.name: Edgefield
apps.short_description: Edgefield is a mix of the adult visual novel, dating sim and point-and-click adventure genres with a wide and colorful cast of characters to meet, befriend, and romance (in fully animated scenes) as you make your way through your freshman year at Edgefield University.

apps.name: Eight Legs, Seven Nights
apps.short_description: Aunt Margit hasn't read your messages in nine days. At her house, a note asks you to look after her thirteen spiders for a week. You are terrified of spiders. Then the snow closes the roads. Feed them, mist them, keep them alive, and get through seven nights in a house that isn't empty.

apps.name: Eldkin
apps.short_description: Cosy creature-collecting in a living pixel world. Bond with and evolve over 130 kin, battle side by side in real time and ride them through sky, sea and lava. Flood caves, burn forests and blast tunnels with your kin, alone or with up to three friends, and face six titans to restore the sun.

apps.name: ELEVEN RISING
apps.short_description: They said you'd be gone by Christmas. Become a football manager: choose your squad, set roles and tactics, plan training and find players in the transfer market. Follow live matches, pause to adjust tactics and substitutions, and build your career alongside the people at your club.

apps.name: Elfscape: Ancestors
apps.short_description: Elfscape: Ancestors is a story-driven, old-school platformer with RPG elements. Explore a vast underground world centered around an ancient temple city. Jump your way through challenging obstacles, decorate the city, and collect comics pages.

apps.name: Elk, Grove's Last Guard
apps.short_description: Defend the sacred grove against an endless wave of living shadows. Fight the horde with a horde of your own creation, wield strange powers, and survive increasingly chaotic battles from every direction.

apps.name: Elysian Realms
apps.short_description: A pixel-art tower defense for PC. Hold the road across seven realms. Each one changes a rule of the game, not the scenery. Every run, won or lost, feeds a skill tree that carries over to the next. No account, no telemetry: it runs on your machine and nowhere else.

apps.name: Embershadow: Forbidden Realm
apps.short_description: Take on the role of Shi Chi, a female mercenary, in this immersive third-person action shooter. Survive on a millennia-old quarantined island tainted by an ancient virus. Fight grotesque mutants, solve deadly puzzles, and expose the truth behind twisted cults and military bioweapon experiments.

apps.name: Emory Cole & The Secret at Greymar Point
apps.short_description: A cozy, point & click first-person detective adventure where you explore a Pacific Northwest coastal town, talk to quirky townies, solve layered puzzles, investigate clues, and uncover a century-old secret.

apps.name: Enter the Gungeon 2
apps.short_description: Enter the Gungeon 2 is a reloaded, high-caliber sequel to the iconic bullet hell dungeon crawler, reinforced with a new 3D art style, new weapons and enemies, and new gameplay tricks.

apps.name: Erulean Angel: Fantasy Commander
apps.short_description: Set out on a grand adventure of exploration, strategy, and mystery in Erulean Angel: Fantasy Commander. Immerse yourself in a handmade world as you craft armies to outwit your opponents in fully simulated autobattler combat.

apps.name: Escape With The Money
apps.short_description: Race against the clock, collect as much money as you can, and escape before time runs out. The platforms change position in every game, creating new challenges and making each run unique.

apps.name: Evacuation
apps.short_description: Evacuation is an unofficial story-driven add-on for Half-life 2, telling the story of an rebel who crashes on a helicopter in the woods. Having miraculously survived, the hero picks up a walkie-talkie and decides to escape from the forest, which was attacked by the Combine.

apps.name: Evil Remnant
apps.short_description: Your new life begins with the perfect job offer—until your daughter mysteriously disappears. In Evil Remnanat, a first-person horror experience, uncover the secrets of a dark house, solve puzzles, and discover the truth behind that terrifying night.

apps.name: Ewetopia
apps.short_description: A simple desktop companion game where sheep eat grass and develop personalities while you work. Connect to your friends, place new activities, and watch your sheep experience what it’s like to be alive.

apps.name: Exodus Directive
apps.short_description: Earth is lost. You are the Ferryman of the Last. Guide a generation ship through the dark: from a single terminal you command power, air, water and food, and keep the last humans alive. A bleak survival sim about responsibility, loss and hope.

apps.name: Exposed Livestream: Gamble
apps.short_description: Overcome your fears and become a live streamer in this RPG adventure game! Play as Honomi, a shy girl who needs to earn 1 million yen. Stream in public, fulfill viewer challenges, push your limits, and discover how far you'll go for bigger payouts. Show your viewers what they really want to see!

apps.name: Farm Factory
apps.short_description: Farm Factory is a cozy farming automation game. Plant six empty fields by hand, then build sprinklers, harvesters, mills, bakeries and conveyor belts until your farm runs itself. Research, upgrade, raise animals, sell on a living market and grow Grandma's farm into a factory that feeds the world.

apps.name: Farwoods
apps.short_description: A world of storybook roleplaying inspired by works like Redwall and Ironclaw. Join a player-driven living world of fantasy and adventure, contribute to the player-run economy, and help contribute to the organic narratives created by the community.

apps.name: FD's Industry Tycoon
apps.short_description: Build a global industrial empire from a 1990s desktop. A retro business management sim, hand-drawn in pixel art. Alone or in MP: open factories worldwide, broker supply deals across continents, and acquire rivals when they falter. Markets shift, empires grow, and the CRT flickers.

apps.name: Femboy Futa Cruise
apps.short_description: One ocean liner. €4.2 million in debt. Fourteen nights to save her. Inherit the Pink Pearl, romance a cast of femboys and futas, follow a trail of hidden pearls, and uncover sabotage in an adult visual novel filled with Mediterranean romance, mystery, and minigames.

apps.name: FerroFrame
apps.short_description: FerroFrame is a real-time strategy  ecology simulator — dig, dam, redirect and blast industry into high gear, then survive the world as the balance tilts in either direction. Use gigantic mechs called frames to terraform the planet to your needs and replenish your world with asteroids!

apps.name: Fervent: Sovereign Struggle
apps.short_description: A dark fantasy stealth-action game set in a world ruled by rival gods. You play as an Apostle, sent to carry out your god's divine will, while he wages war beyond the mortal realm.  Too weak to challenge divine powers directly, you must exploit and sabotage from within and await final judgement.

apps.name: Fibonex
apps.short_description: Turn numbers into firepower. Build conveyor lines, calculate the ammunition your towers need and defend your Core in this single-player factory and tower-defense game. Reach the first boss, keep going in Endless, or experiment in Sandbox with or without enemies.

apps.name: Final Tactics
apps.short_description: This is a f2p online tactical turn based strategy 1v1 grid-based pvp game (with pve) and infinite replayability; you can play this the rest of your life. There are 140+ BALANCED units with move/attack and 4 abilities, & i'll always be adding more. Use your entire army every turn. No P2W, pure skill.

apps.name: Find Cats 9: Hidden Treasures
apps.short_description: Three epic fantasy battlefields, dozens of sneaky cats! Crown battles in the treasury, mermaids vs. skeleton pirates in a deep-sea wreck, dwarves vs. goblins for an ale flagon in the gold vault—find them all!

apps.name: Fire Tactics
apps.short_description: Fire Tactics is a top-down vehicular combat and capture-the-flag game where you pilot jeeps, tanks, helicopters, and armored support vehicles. Storm enemy bases, steal their flag, and race it home in local or online multiplayer, or build and share your own maps with the built-in level editor.

apps.name: Five Five Six
apps.short_description: An upcomming VR first person shooter focused on realism and graphics and competitive gameplay.

apps.name: Flame Cycle
apps.short_description: FlameCycle is a brutal, ultra-minimalist open-world soulslike. Start at the bottom of the food chain, build an infinite deck of combat abilities, and adapt as the world radically metamorphoses with every single death.

apps.name: Flaunt
apps.short_description: Pour, stir, shake and layer real liquids in a 2D fluid simulation. Serve more than 100 classic cocktails, beers and mocktails to impatient guests, keep your bar spotless, pay the rent and win over the hidden critics whose awards make your bar famous.

apps.name: FLICK: Knockout
apps.short_description: Every flick counts in FLICK: Knockout, a physics-driven competitive arena game. Aim your shot, knock rivals out, and turn precise hits into big plays. Build your puck lineup, master the angles, and switch things up in BOB mode. Small move. Big consequences.

apps.name: Flowers to Honey
apps.short_description: A cozy incremental where you choose how your bees evolve, plant flowers, guide your hive, and grow a thriving honey empire.

apps.name: Fly Raid
apps.short_description: Tiny wings. Big trouble. Dodge household hazards, grab snacks and battle six predators in a pixel-art arcade escape. Explore six areas, chase your best score, and earn coins to unlock 20 fly looks and four gadgets. No ads or in-game purchases.

apps.name: Football Star Life ! 26/27
apps.short_description: Create your player, prove yourself season after season, sign for new clubs, represent your country and compete for football’s greatest trophies. Every performance shapes your future, every decision changes your path, and every career tells a different story

apps.name: Forgotten Horizons
apps.short_description: Wake beside a dying fire with no memory and explore a world that forgets itself: five regions, a forgotten temple, a silent fortress, deep mines and the floating islands of the Aether. Fight, fish, build a home and raise a dragon.

apps.name: Fortnight Before Christmas
apps.short_description: Grimwald the Frost King marches on Hollyhearth for fourteen nights. Build a cozy Christmas village, raise toy soldiers, nutcrackers and snow golems from its buildings, and break each night's boss before the clock runs out. Hold the gate until Christmas morning!

apps.name: Fox7: City Of Fighters
apps.short_description: Explore 10 cities, build your fighter through boxing, kickboxing, wrestling and MMA, then battle using strategic cards, submissions and whatever the street puts within reach. Rise from bar fights and underground pits to become king of the cage.

apps.name: Fractal Forge: Sierpinski's Sanctuary
apps.short_description: An incremental idler about recursively creating several famous fractals, managing your workers, and balancing multiple production lines to prevail against the exponential growth inherent in the mathematics of fractals.

apps.name: Frog Collector
apps.short_description: Bring order to a shop overflowing with collectible frogs. Pick up and sort colorful figures, fill themed shelves, unlock helpful upgrades, and search for hidden eggs. Build your collection one frog at a time.

apps.name: FROG IS CRIME
apps.short_description: Complete unhinged jobs in the BEST OPEN WORLD CRIME game of 2026 or cry trying!

apps.name: FrontierCraft
apps.short_description: FrontierCraft is a massively multiplayer sandbox set on one vast, fully destructible planet. Twenty kingdoms, thousands of ruins, and every player in the same world. Mine, build, trade and fight. Help kingdoms rise or fall, raise your clan's banner and carve out your place on the frontier.

apps.name: Frontlines: World in Conflict
apps.short_description: Command armies across a detailed 3D war table. Capture territories, secure bonus regions and outplan rival commanders in six-player online battles, solo skirmishes and guided training. Choose your rules, customise your commander and conquer the world.

apps.name: FrostHaul
apps.short_description: The Great Frost has swallowed the south. Command the last train out of a dying city and grow it into a city on rails: heat its cars, keep its crew alive, raid frozen outposts for coal and iron, and stay ahead of the White Wall, the storm that never stops following you north.

apps.name: Frostliner
apps.short_description: The moon shattered. The world froze. Take command of a nomadic train city hurtling through a war-ravaged frozen wasteland. In this survival city builder on rails, gather survivors, scavenge resources, and do whatever it takes to keep the engine running and stay ahead of the frost.

apps.name: Fruit Kombat
apps.short_description: The viral brain-rot fruit novela, now a chaotic 3D fighting game. Live the soap-opera betrayals and the reveals nobody asked for while fruit brawlers settle it in the gym. Farm aura to unleash weapon ultimates, in offline duels and online PvP.

apps.name: Func Key
apps.short_description: Func Key is a spelling roguelike deck builder where your keyboard is the deck! Customize your keyboard to be the ultimate spelling machine, or leave words behind with rule breaking mods. Spell, build, and relax, all to the soothing thock of the keyboard.

apps.name: Furniture Supply & Market Simulator
apps.short_description: Manage every step of your furniture business. Unload containers with cranes, drive forklifts to organize stock, and design your store for customers. Handle logistics alone or with friends in co-op. A realistic simulation focused on deep mechanics, from port shipments to in-store sales.

apps.name: Furthia Trails
apps.short_description: Meet Liam, the Doggaroo. Meet Liam, the Doggaroo. After a cliffside tumble, he finds himself lost in the mysterious Goomshi Forest - a wild and dangerous place full of strange, alluring creatures with their own instincts.

apps.name: Fuwamee: Sheep’s New Year! - Out Now
apps.short_description: 2027 is the Year of the Sheep! Float a woolly sheep up to the New Year's dawn, count sheep to the beat, herd your flock home before midnight, and more. Nine bite-sized sheep minigames, each playable in minutes - some with a friend, versus or co-op - plus high scores and leaderboards to chase.

apps.name: Galanost
apps.short_description: A cozy co-op village game for 1 to 8 players. Welcome new neighbors, build your village together and fill the tavern at night. Meet the island's wildlife and live through every season. At the bottom of the old mine, a sealed door waits.

apps.name: Game Dev Dynasty
apps.short_description: Create the game of your dreams in this studio management tycoon. Design game covers, lead your team and compete in a living market. Outsell rivals, win Game of the Year, and build the most prestigious game studio in the world.

apps.name: Gang
apps.short_description: Five rival gangs. One city. One turf war waiting to explode. Shoot your way through ever-changing streets with an arsenal of ridiculous weapons. Blast enemies with bread, fire books like cannonballs, and send rival bosses to their knees. It's a dog-eat-dog world. Good thing your boss is a cat.

apps.name: Gaslamp Cases 12: The Silent Codex
apps.short_description: In this thrilling Match-3 adventure you have to uncover a deadly mystery. When Nobel-winning Professor Lyle Hemsworth dies under mysterious circumstances, detectives Morgan Johnson and Jack Brown are pulled into a chilling investigation that blurs the line between reality and madness

apps.name: Gay Cape Diaries
apps.short_description: Deon just landed a job at a high-powered law firm. There’s one problem: he looks exactly like someone else who works there. A steamy, funny gay romance visual novel about mistaken identity, office secrets, and finally letting go.

apps.name: GeneJinks: Sports Festival
apps.short_description: Breed unusual creatures, build skill loadouts and take direct control in seven sports events, from arena clashes to forest races. Play solo or host an online game so friends can join over the internet and compete together.

apps.name: Generation Nova
apps.short_description: Manage a colony of people who woke too soon from their cryo-sleep. Build and manage a working generation ship and hopefully one day the grandchildren of the first generation might land on a habitable planet.

apps.name: Generations utopia
apps.short_description: A secret Soviet research institute is conducting an experiment to create a utopian city. Develop your city, resolve generational conflicts, and overcome the challenges prepared by the institute.

apps.name: Genigods: Nezha
apps.short_description: Genigods: Nezha is an ARPG rooted in the chaos of ancient Chinese creation mythology. Play as Spirit Pearl, the first being forged by the Goddess of Creation Nüwa. Dive into iconic Chinese genesis tales, battle Colossal Gods, and experience the unique combat of Chinese-style celestial showdowns.

apps.name: Glims
apps.short_description: A battle pet that lives on your desktop. Your glims walk your taskbar, live in a 3D house you decorate and earn gold on their own. When you call, they hold off an invasion on your screen or dive a 20-floor dungeon. Free, light, and it works offline.

apps.name: Glyphwild
apps.short_description: Glyphwild is a 3D bullet-heaven roguelite where runes combine. Socket a fireball under a lightning rune and fireballs rain on shocked foes. Wire wild rune chains, carve through thousands of creatures and towering bosses across 6 living vales, alone or in online co-op.

apps.name: Gnomes Garden: Fairy Kingdom
apps.short_description: The Gnome Queen uncovers the history of the fairies, restores friendship, and fights an ancient darkness.

apps.name: Goblington
apps.short_description: A rogue-lite style city-building game in a relaxed dark fantasy world. Explore your goblin kingdom, find interesting locations and choose your heroes. Defeat hordes of monsters, harvest, build, cook, feed and grow. Good luck!

apps.name: Goblins Gotta Go
apps.short_description: Goblins Gotta Go is a toon inspired incremental where you smash goblins in the name of the Kingdom. Fill in your quota with your many skills, upgrades and items before time runs out or the King may just demand your head!

apps.name: Godborne: Ashes of Ramessu
apps.short_description: A first‑person tower defense hybrid where you summon towers that fight off waves of enemies while you solve the puzzles of the ancient ruins around you.

apps.name: Godmantle
apps.short_description: Godmantle is a single-player card battler inspired by mythology. Choose three of six deities to empower three suits, combine their arcana with poker-style hands, and refine your build between battles against bosses with distinct abilities.

apps.name: GODSCALE
apps.short_description: GODSCALE is a 2D pixel art action roguelike set in an ancient Egyptian tomb. Face monsters, deadly traps, and powerful curses while managing blades, spells, and artifacts. Upgrade abilities in the Book of the Dead, collect Ankh tokens, and master the crypt to claim the gods' power.

apps.name: Gold Admiral
apps.short_description: Explore, trade, research, and fight across a turn-based naval strategy sandbox. Found coastal cities, command fleets and armies, clear pirate hideouts and dungeons, and shape each campaign through economy, diplomacy, or conquest.

apps.name: Gospel Drift
apps.short_description: Let grandma take the wheel! Kick Satans whiny little ass and collect the souls of the damned to buy upgrades and slam the hordes that stand in your way...literally.

apps.name: Gourmet Zombie
apps.short_description: Imprisoned in a mansion's cellar, you're the personal chef of Toufic, the Gourmet Zombie. Master real knife techniques, fight off the infected with kitchen tools and butcher the fallen in a PS1-style survival horror where you're either the chef… or the dish!

apps.name: Grand Bonk
apps.short_description: Your crew vs. every cop in town. Grand Bonk is a 4-player co-op horde survival roguelite: hold your block against an entire police department, level up a build that's all yours, stack it until it breaks, and bonk every wave that dares show up.

apps.name: Grandpa Loves Trains
apps.short_description: Grandpa has retired and now spends his days playing with his toy trains. With the station needing a new conductor, the responsibility falls to his grandson, Abraham. Board passengers, unlock powerful abilities through a skill tree, and expand your railway empire in this cozy incremental roguelite.

apps.name: Grape Stomper
apps.short_description: Stomp grapes barefoot! A first-person incremental game inspired by traditional winemaking. Crush grapes, sell wine, and buy upgrades to automate your winery. Go from barefoot stomping to rows of busy machines, earning more each day. Secrets await deep in the cellar.

apps.name: Grave Profits
apps.short_description: Auto-battler Dungeoncrawler without PvP in a Dark Fantasy setting. Recruit, Match 3 to level up, build game breaking synergies with items and unlocks. Supports 2 player online CO-OP

apps.name: GraveWell
apps.short_description: Defend the last Beacons in a first-person tower defense where you build on the battlefield and fight alongside your towers. Place defenses freely, wield weapons and powerful abilities, and battle through 24 handcrafted levels with over 150 tower variants.

apps.name: Greed Grind Golden
apps.short_description:
A deck‑building roguelike where you grow your deck little by little by returning from your adventure.
Bring back the cards you’ve collected and strengthen your deck at your own pace.

apps.name: Green Again!
apps.short_description: A pure logic puzzle that combines Minesweeper-style number deduction with water-line coverage on a hexagonal grid.

apps.name: GRIDDLE 66
apps.short_description: GRIDDLE 66 is a hands-on fast-food job simulator. Grill burgers, prepare fries and drinks, serve customers, and clean up after each shift. Work solo or in 2-player online co-op, sharpen your skills, and rise from part-timer to the Hall of Fame.

apps.name: Grove Bound
apps.short_description: Grove Bound is a cozy incremental woodcutting RPG where you chop, fish, cook, mine, and craft to explore a dark forest. Manage fatigue, light your way with a lantern, and upgrade tools while meeting quirky NPCs and uncovering secrets at your own pace.

apps.name: HANAE // PRIMARY
apps.short_description: A first-person psychological story game: You are Hanae, trapped in a distorted game world. Evilnae wants to take your place and rebuilds everything after every escape attempt. Find the cracks, write everything down and escape... before it's too late.

apps.name: Happily Never After
apps.short_description: Happily Never After is a low-poly retro adventure with psychological horror elements set in a surreal, distorted Lebanon. Drive through eerie streets, solve unsettling puzzles, and survive everyday absurdities turned nightmarish as you uncover the dark secrets of a corrupted reality.

apps.name: Harper and Lyre
apps.short_description: Jump into Harper and Lyre's adventure! Control a red panda and otter duo through classic 3D platforming action. Jump, collect, explore colorful worlds, unlock transformations, solve puzzles, and battle enemies in this nostalgic adventure inspired by beloved N64 classics.

apps.name: Haunted Echoes
apps.short_description: Haunted Echoes is a raw psychological horror game experienced through a bodycam perspective. Explore abandoned, eerie locations, manage your limited flashlight, face terrifying anomalies hidden in the dark, and try to survive a nightmare where every single move is being recorded.

apps.name: Hedge-Wizard Cocktail
apps.short_description: A not-so-cozy apothecary simulator. Explore, gather reagents, craft wicked concoctions and haggle with adventurers, alone or with friends, in a dangerous, dark fantasy world. Complete quests and expand your alchemical expertise to grow your shop before the horrors of the Hedge destroy you.

apps.name: Hell Hell
apps.short_description: Hell Hell is a cooperative action stealth game that combines "tag" and "hide-and-seek. Players must work together to collect items in the stage as ordered, summon gates and escape from prison within a time limit, while hiding or running away to avoid detection by the demon that roam the stage.

apps.name: Heroes of the Forgotten Land
apps.short_description: A Norse fantasy tower defense. Build and upgrade five tower types, lead heroes into battle, forge runes and rebuild your village as you push back the darkness across forest, frost and fire. Twelve chapters, three game modes.

apps.name: Hexamonia
apps.short_description: A cozy, strategic board game where every choice matters. Place hex tiles, make the most of the options you’re dealt, and build the most valuable kingdom in the land.

apps.name: Hey, Izumi, Watch This!
apps.short_description: It is a visual novel game about two women. The protagonist, who is a university student, goes for a walk late at night. An unknown woman points a gun at the protagonist and asks her whether she will follow her or not. After following her, they decide to live outdoors together for a while, but...

apps.name: Hikki Life
apps.short_description: A story-driven action-adventure about a shut-in who flees people into video games. A talking cat leads him to a parallel world, where he fights in a dungeon, grows stronger, seeks his missing grandfather, and regains his memories. But the further he goes, the less that world looks like the truth.

apps.name: Hit The Beer
apps.short_description: Hit The Beer is a lightweight idle collection game that stays in the corner of your desktop. Your anonymous keyboard rhythm brews different beers without recording what you type, attracting customers with unique tastes to come and sample them.

apps.name: HITLER BACKROOMS
apps.short_description: HITLER BACKROOMS is a co-op game for 1-6 players, where you must make your way through the Backrooms while avoiding the Hitler entity. Explore the Backrooms alone, or with friends! Progress through the levels and try to survive. Will you find the way out? Or will another hidden world await?

apps.name: Hockey Coach Dynasty
apps.short_description: Coach your way from high-school and AAA 18U benches to the top of world hockey. Run the lines, the systems, the training and the room; answer the board; take the job that calls. A text-first career sim across 140 leagues and 2,109 clubs — and every name is yours to edit.

apps.name: Hollow Galley
apps.short_description: When deep-sea research vessel goes silent above a hydrothermal vent field, Rin Kessler docks alone to find her missing brother. Manage scarce ammunition against mutated crew members and unearth the Nocturne program in this hand-drawn, anime cel-shaded third-person survival horror mystery.

apps.name: Home Before Dusk
apps.short_description: Farm, cook and fall in love in a fenced town at the end of the world. Once a week, a helicopter flies you out to abandoned towns for fuel, medicine and parts. Search fast and get back on board before dusk: the pilots don't wait for anyone.

apps.name: Home Reset: Organizing Simulator
apps.short_description: Transform messy homes into cozy, beautifully organized spaces. Clean up, arrange every room, and place objects wherever you want—there are no wrong choices. Relax, get creative, and make every home feel just right.

apps.name: Homemaking: Build & Decorate
apps.short_description: Build a home from the first wall to the last cushion: draw the rooms, paper the walls and furnish them from a thousand pieces. Walk through homes built by other players, rate them and get your own homes rated.

apps.name: HONKSHOT
apps.short_description: HONKSHOT is a fast-paced arcade car-combat game where you drift, jump, and blast your way to ten eliminations in four-car Deathmatch! Play online with friends, practice solo against bots, or take on 20-car Weapon Race and Junkyard Royale.

apps.name: Horde of Distraction
apps.short_description: An incremental game inspired by classic RPGs. Fight monsters, collect rare gear, progress through a vast skill tree, and defeat powerful bosses!

apps.name: Hordebound
apps.short_description: A 3D co-op survivor roguelike for 1 to 4 players. Pick a champion, run and slide through a horde of hundreds, stack auto-firing weapons into absurd builds, beat the boss and get out alive. Seven biomes, 29 champions, and a horde to destory.

apps.name: Horror Simulator
apps.short_description: A night shift at the precinct turns into a nightmare when the terrifying "Subject #4" breaks free from the basement. No weapons, locked doors, dead comms. Navigate a maze of hallways, crack safes, and hide in the dark. Your shift lasts until 08:00. Will you live to see the dawn?

apps.name: Hot Pot Pizza Edition
apps.short_description: Slice, bake, box and serve under pressure in a fast-paced first-person pizza game. Survive chaotic shifts, unlock kitchens and truck cosmetics, and go from a messy garage to your own restaurant.

apps.name: House of Wardians: Unchained
apps.short_description: Recruit, customize and evolve your Wardians, then send them into fast automatic battles where strategy is decided before the fight. Combine species, classes, weapons, skills and guardian spirits into your perfect build, and climb seasonal leagues against other players' Wardians.

apps.name: HoverShot
apps.short_description: Shooting is the only way to move. Master zero-gravity combat where every shot is both movement and attack. Experiment with weapons and stackable items that change how you fight and move. Unlock new characters and abilities as you battle through each roguelite run.

apps.name: Hunter Road
apps.short_description:
Earn gold by capturing and dismantling monsters?
Buy rifles at the shop?
Defeated allies vanish forever?
Welcome to the new standard of permadeath 2D monster-hunting RPGs.
Experience a retro, yet refreshingly addictive gaming adventure.

apps.name: I Am Cat: Vacation
apps.short_description: Your favorite cat is going on vacation! Explore sunny beaches, swim with colorful fish, build sandcastles, dig for hidden treasures, and enjoy fun mini-games. Join Granny and her grandson for a brand-new sandbox adventure full of surprises and cat chaos!

apps.name: I just wanted a marshmallow.
apps.short_description: 'I just wanted a marshmallow.' is a casual completely normal take on the arena shooter genre. Falling into the pits of despair over not having a marshmallow, you and your crew opt to take the matters into their own hands. There's not much else to say about this game.

apps.name: I'd Choose the Bear
apps.short_description: Thirty days to save your late Nana's cottage in Honeywood, a lakeside town where bears and people live side by side. Date six very different bears (one of them is technically a human), outwit a resort developer, and decide who you'd really rather meet in the woods.

apps.name: I, Crafter #48
apps.short_description: Earth is out of room. Fifty people were sent asleep to fifty worlds. You are #48. You land with knowledge and nothing else: no supplies, no loot, no help. Craft fire, shelter and walls, bring back the creatures you kill as workers, and build the transmitter that tells Earth this world can hold us.

apps.name: Idle Camp Tale
apps.short_description: A fantasy idle RPG. Manage your camp, recruit heroes, and let auto-battles fight for you. Farm gear and materials from every fight, then strengthen, enchant, and customize affixes to forge your own powerful equipment as you conquer the frontier stage by stage!

apps.name: Idle Cultivator: Ascend Together
apps.short_description: Idle Cultivator is a multiplayer idle loot RPG set in a world of Chinese fantasy. Auto-battle beasts and bosses, collect and upgrade gear, and grow stronger. Adventure solo or team up online with up to three friends to take on tougher challenges!

apps.name: Idle Harmony
apps.short_description:
An idle game where you build compositions to earn money. Unlock notes, chords, instruments & effects then evolve your melody. 
Experiment and make the next big hit, export & share it anywhere!

apps.name: Idle Primes
apps.short_description: A cursed incremental horror game with PSX-style graphics. Find a strange CD-ROM, boot it on your bedroom computer, and click prime numbers to buy upgrades and automate the search, while something on the other side of the screen takes an interest in you. ████████████████████ Belphegor's ██████!

apps.name: Idle Slot Machine
apps.short_description: Build slot machines, automate them with monkeys, stop gorillas and eagles, unlock upgrades, earn more money, and grow your own chaotic idle empire.

apps.name: IJIN: History Survivors
apps.short_description: Who's the strongest in history? Become Napoleon, Musashi, or Cleopatra and mow down huge hordes in survivors-style action. Just move — attacks are automatic. Evolve each legend's weapon into their myth. Ice at Austerlitz, fog at Sekigahara rewrite the battlefield. 4-player online/local co-op.

apps.name: In Her Service
apps.short_description: Jack and Sylvia work as servants in Talia Godroy's house to clear a debt. What begins as work becomes something neither of them planned. A branching adult visual novel about romance, desire and jealousy — 20+ hours, 16 endings, no way to see them all in one run.

apps.name: INKURSION
apps.short_description: You’re a newly super-sentient octopus trapped inside a game, and your unhinged creator watches your every move. Escape his abandoned worlds, question the characters left behind, and uncover the hidden truth across 8 endings.

apps.name: Inside Job
apps.short_description: Escape prison in co-op with 1–4 players – or survive LAST COUNT with up to 10: no teams, deadly games, only one walks out. Work the inmates, trade, gamble, and pick your moment.

apps.name: Irkalla
apps.short_description: Conquer Irkalla, a world of mortals torn apart by a war between eight civilizations! Command heroes, forge and break alliances, journey through five eras of history, and choose one of the Seven Truths to change the face of reality forever. A turn-based 4X strategy game.

apps.name: Irongrim Tower
apps.short_description: Tower defense meets city building in a grimdark sci-fi world. Build vertically, manage resources, defend against alien hordes, and command machine priests in humanity's last stronghold.

apps.name: It's Always Grey: Serial Detective Stories
apps.short_description: It's Always Grey is a detective mystery serial, inspired by real true crime cases. In a city of perpetual rain, Detective Molly Grey investigates a horrific discovery made years after the crime took place. Search for clues, highlight critical evidence, and connect the dots to find those responsible.

apps.name: ItemDay
apps.short_description:
Survive the nightmare in ItemDay, an asymmetrical 1v4 multiplayer hide-and-seek game! 

As a Survivor, transform into props, blend in the map, and try to stay alive. 
As the Hunter, track down the Survivors and make sure none of them escape. 

Will you hide, or will you hunt?

apps.name: Jiggle Desktop Lab 2D
apps.short_description: Meet your new bouncy desktop companion! Jiggle Desktop 2D brings your screen to life with satisfying, reactive physics. Poke, drag, and play with your interactive virtual pet while you work, browse, or game.

apps.name: Jin Ping Mei: Qinghe Reverie
apps.short_description: In Qinghe County during the Northern Song, manage businesses and household affairs, build relationships, gather rumors and evidence, and set schemes in motion. As Ximen Qing, balance time, wealth, reputation and favors while your choices reshape lives, fortunes and endings.

apps.name: Juke's Quest for Harmony
apps.short_description: ♪ Juke is a curious little robot who shares music with others to keep the world safe from what he fears most. Join him on an unforgettable journey and uncover the roots behind the misery of the Kordian realm. ♪

apps.name: K-God Robot Hunters
apps.short_description: A Korean-fantasy poker roguelike where you build hands from five elemental suits and harness the powers of mythic goddesses. Refine your deck, discover powerful combinations, and battle through a robot uprising one hand at a time.

apps.name: Kaiju Crash
apps.short_description: A real-time action game playing as Kaiju on a fully destructible map with real-time physics and collision. As you level up, choose your upgrades from fire, lightning, acid, and others. Defend yourself, eat people, topple buildings, and watch them fall.  Make them pay!

apps.name: Keepguard
apps.short_description: Keepguard is a medieval tower-defense roguelite where the map is your build. Expand and defend your kingdom: bind towers to powerful rites, uncover unusual relics and create game-breaking synergies to keep back the endless hordes.

apps.name: Kerb Kids
apps.short_description: Kerb Kids uses a simple point-and-click interface and also has joypad support. It is structured across a seven day format, with each day featuring tasks that involve crossing roads safely. Players guide a character through street scenarios, learning to identify safe crossings etc.

apps.name: Kesselgrid
apps.short_description: Turn-based grand strategy on a hex map, set in the Great War and in the Second World War. Run a nation's industry, politics and diplomacy, command its armies, fleets and air force, and break the enemy front. Play alone against the AI, in co-op or online against your friends.

apps.name: Keystrike
apps.short_description: Craft powerful synergies and overcome game-changing drawbacks in this bullet-hell roguelike where the enemies evolve with you.

apps.name: Kid on Couch Quest
apps.short_description: Welcome to Kid On Couch Quest – an action-packed 2D platform shooter where adorable characters face dangerous monsters, powerful bosses, and tons of loot! Fight your way through hordes of monsters alone or with your friends, or challenge each other in thrilling arena battles!

apps.name: KILLWATT
apps.short_description: One yard, one night, twelve waves of the dead. Every running generator steadies your aim — and its roar pulls the horde to that wall. Build, hire and draft between waves, then catch the dawn convoy… or stay one more wave for a bigger payout.

apps.name: King Alone
apps.short_description: Tower Defence meets minimalist Action Strategy. Ride as the King, protecting everything you have left, and the Queen, blinded by your enemies.

apps.name: KINGDOM OF REQUIEM
apps.short_description:
"The truth sits under a mountain of lies and deception..."

KINGDOM OF REQUIEM is a royal drama-based fantasy visual novel following the lives of various royals, their courts, and the embittered emperor who threatens to upend their lives.

apps.name: Kings & Savages
apps.short_description:
A fast-paced, high skill Solo/Auto-Battler.

Easy to learn, hard to master. 

Inspired by Chess and Dota.

apps.name: Kings Trader
apps.short_description: King's Trader is a medieval trading tycoon with a combo system. Buy low, sell high, and stack combos to multiply your profit. Pay the king's tax, unlock new markets, and build the perfect basket.

apps.name: Kizoku no Kage
apps.short_description: Kizoku no Kage ( Noble Shadows ) is a lovingly crafted stealth action game inspired by the legendary Tenchu series.

apps.name: Kokuhaku Confessional
apps.short_description: Just as you’re finally ready to ask library crush Shiori out on a date, mean girls Maika, Rin, and Aoi swoop in with a twisted new game: Kokuhaku Confessional! Can you resist their charms and stay true to your beloved?

apps.name: Kpop Infinite
apps.short_description: Build and run your own K-pop entertainment company. Scout trainees, form your idol group, produce comebacks, and guide your artists from a tiny office to a global entertainment empire across generations that never truly end.

apps.name: Kursk Kiosk
apps.short_description: A trading roguelike set in a kiosk in provincial Russia, 2004. Fill a 20-slot board with products, discover profitable combinations, buy upgrades, and meet your sales quotas. Occasionally, the locals will stop by to talk. Fortunately, you can turn that off.

apps.name: Lancer Tactics
apps.short_description: The iconic Lancer TTRPG, adapted to digital. Craft your Lancer from over 500 unique abilities and make your mark on the fight for Union's utopia. Play story-driven narrative campaigns, get right to battle in Instant Action, or build your own combats and campaigns with built-in sandbox editor tools.

apps.name: Land of Manifestations: Sanctuary
apps.short_description: A fantasy RPG blending romance, roguelite shooting, and city building. Awakening in the Tianwen Temple with no memory of the past, you discover that an unknown force is corrupting the Land of Manifestations, twisting Xiangling into monsters. To save the world, you must build a Sanctuary.

apps.name: Last Night Last Call
apps.short_description: Can you solve a murder with only your wits, cocktail shaker, and silver tongue? Last Night Last Call is a narrative detective game where you mix cocktails, interrogate suspects, gather clues, and shape relationships to solve five murders. Every customer has something to hide.

apps.name: Lavender's
apps.short_description: A small cutesy game where you provide magical potions to a variety of strange characters.

apps.name: Leaf It Zen
apps.short_description: Leaf It Zen is a cozy game about clearing cherry blossom petals from a beautiful Japanese garden. Collect petals, upgrade tools, unlock new areas and discover hidden cards featuring Japanese spirits. Relax and enjoy the atmosphere!

apps.name: Leaf to Sun
apps.short_description: Autumn is ending, and the sun grows weaker by the day. Blow fallen leaves into the bonfire to grow the fire, and power up your wind and flames with the skill tree. Before long, the journey heads to space. A relaxing pixel-art incremental game.

apps.name: Left Inside
apps.short_description: Left Inside is a room escape game taking place in a mysterious house. Awoke in an attic, you must find a way to escape using the objects hidden in the rooms.

apps.name: Life of a caveman
apps.short_description:
Live the colorful life of a caveman. 
Eat and interact with other cavemen in order to grow stronger and smarter. 
Once you are strong enough, become the leader of your group and guide them to safety; 
safety from things like the the beast that attacks at night and the other tribe that left tracks in your area.

apps.name: Light From Within
apps.short_description: Light From Within is a top-down action-adventure focused on exploration, dungeon crawling, and discovery. Traverse a handcrafted world, solve puzzles, uncover hidden paths, and collect relics that expand your abilities, boost your stats, and alter how you interact with the environment.

apps.name: Light of Atlantis
apps.short_description:
Explore the depths of the ocean in this 2D-Puzzle-Metroidvania! 
Control the water levels and switch between various robots to solve the ancient puzzles of Atlantis.

apps.name: Liminal Space But You Have to Kabaddi
apps.short_description: “Kabaddi, kabaddi…” Stop chanting, and your health starts to drain. Liminal Space But You Have to Kabaddi is an online co-op horror game where you explore mysterious spaces while chanting “kabaddi” into your microphone.

apps.name: Lingering Shadow
apps.short_description: Lingering Shadow is a psychological horror puzzle game set in a 2000s small town. On her birthday, Lanlan returns home to find her father missing. To find him, she must navigate eerie streets and piece together nostalgic yet unsettling memories to uncover a dark truth.

apps.name: LINGORIA
apps.short_description: 在七款游戏里练外语。在 Idle 战斗中培养你的学生，白天顺手答几张学习卡片；也可以换成赛车、生存、边境检查、公会经营、听写和拼句集市。界面为简体中文，可以学英语、西班牙语、德语、波兰语、俄语和葡萄牙语，学过的单词会通过间隔重复再回来。

apps.name: Little Backpack
apps.short_description: A cozy pixel-art puzzle game about organizing items inside your backpack. There are 48 handcrafted levels made to be relaxing and satisfying to play.

apps.name: Little Token
apps.short_description: Build your deck with words and turn sentences into attacks, shields, and healing. Little Token is a picture-diary roguelite deckbuilder where clever word combinations unlock powerful combos. Join a boy and his fairy companion to protect a story being torn apart.

apps.name: Lola's Familiars
apps.short_description: Escape a demonic underworld prison in this stunning anime inspired lite-vania adventure. Explore mysterious magical realms, forge pacts with powerful Familiar bosses, uncover dark secrets, and guide Lola through an emotional journey of growth in a haunting dark fantasy world.

apps.name: Looting Frogs
apps.short_description: A co-op heist game for up to 6 players. You're tiny frogs breaking into human houses: sneak past homeowners and pets, snatch loot with your grappling-hook tongues, and upgrade your hideout. Expect messy heists, frog-sized chaos, and zero trustworthy teammates.

apps.name: Lord of the Fleet: Idle
apps.short_description: The Galactic Empire is on the brink, and your fleet is its last hope. Fleet King: Idle is a relaxed, satisfying sci-fi idle game — build and grow your space fleet, explore deep space, crush powerful foes, and restore order and peace to the Empire.

apps.name: Lost Luggage
apps.short_description: Buy lost suitcases from flights around the world, crack them open and see what is inside: socks, cameras, gold bricks or a rubber duck. Sell every find on the baggage belt and grow your dusty garage into an automated luggage business.

apps.name: Ludus Magna
apps.short_description: Ludus Magna combines auto-battler combat, gladiator management, and strategic quick-time events in a dark, run-based strategy game set in ancient Rome. Lead your gladiator school as a Lanista, develop unique fighters, manage gold and risk, and keep your House from bankruptcy.

apps.name: Mad Attacks: Castle on Fire
apps.short_description: A frantic roguelite castle defense with deckbuilding elements. The world has fallen to evil. Raise your fantasy castle and survive endless monster hordes. Collect the energy of the fallen and let dark powers tempt you with gifts like knights, wizards, towers and walls. Choose wisely. Grow strong.

apps.name: Mad Cafe
apps.short_description: Serve coffee, pastries, and smiles to increasingly disturbing customers in this atmospheric psychological horror game. Keep the café running, master the perfect brew, and try not to lose yourself as each shift becomes more unsettling than the last.

apps.name: Magic Castle: Tidy Up The Kingdom
apps.short_description: Wield a magic wand and rebuild a scattered fairy-tale castle piece by piece in this cozy first-person game. Charm stones into place, sweep away rubble, earn upgrades and restore five enchanted halls, alone or in online co-op with up to 4 mages.

apps.name: MAGICAL ANGEL PRINCESS LYNN
apps.short_description: Flashy action with the adorable Princess Lynn! Fight against the mysterious invaders threatening the city.

apps.name: Magus Slayer
apps.short_description: Every magus you break drops an eye, and the eye gives you its spell. One click fires all your stolen spells in the order you set, so a black hole cast before the swords makes them burst out of it in a ring. A gothic action roguelite with 40 spells to steal and 16 wings.

apps.name: Maiden Dormireve
apps.short_description: Hotel Dormireve, a dimensional hotel, is falling apart. Join its manager Dayna, the Demon King's daughter, on runs into nightmare-eroded wings and get out alive with the loot. Fight with her magic revolver Tyrfing, restore the hotel, pay off its debt and search for her missing father.

apps.name: Mall Chaos
apps.short_description: The mall is closed, and your shift has just begun. Explore a multi-floor shopping mall in first person, pick up scattered products, and return them to the right shelves, tables, and racks.

apps.name: Manabies
apps.short_description: Embark on an action adventure across floating islands where magical creatures, fast-paced arena battles, and an ever-growing flying base hide a unique twist: every battle is powered by real mathematics, helping you become smarter with every challenge.

apps.name: Maple and Aluna
apps.short_description: Fight together as Maple and Aluna in this action-adventure roguelike. Slaughter foes, capture altars, and augment yourself with powerful mystics to survive the eternal winter.

apps.name: MARS3077
apps.short_description: A pixel-art action RPG and independent spiritual successor inspired by Metal Max on the Famicom. Pilot a transforming ferry-mech, explore Mars and nine other worlds, customize weapons and skills, and uncover the mystery of pilot 404.

apps.name: Matter of State
apps.short_description: Boil, freeze, melt and condense matter on its way across small island boards, in as few parts as you can. 184 puzzles, a new one every day, and a level editor with Workshop sharing.

apps.name: MechInfection
apps.short_description: Co-op survival horror for 2–4 players. By day, scavenge supplies across shifting locations; by night, defend your shelter from the things outside. Craft weapons, set traps, cook, survive together, and break out of a dead world before dawn.

apps.name: MeloMisterio -play your melody-
apps.short_description: MeloMisterio is a music-driven 3D platformer where every action you take creates melodies. Use those melodies to control mechanics and reach the goal.

apps.name: Melted Valor: The Plastic Crusade
apps.short_description: The Green Army replaced them. Now the Tan want their plastic back. Fight through a brutal single-player third-person campaign as a desperate toy war erupts from the shelves into the human world. Every toy, insect and machine is dragged into the conflict.

apps.name: Memory Games Squirrels
apps.short_description: This game is a memory game with multiple levels and beautiful graphics. Enjoy!

apps.name: Merchant Miles
apps.short_description:
A good merchant knows what to sell. A great one knows where, when, how, and to whom. 

Fill your cart with wares, haggle your way through towns, and keep an eye on the shifting market in this travelling merchant strategy game. Just be wary that today’s bargain could be tomorrow’s loss.

apps.name: Mighty Giants
apps.short_description: A fast-paced action game where you battle massive giants, master powerful abilities, dodge devastating attacks, and defeat unique bosses with distinct mechanics in intense, skill-based combat designed to test your timing, strategy, and reflexes.

apps.name: Mikael The Apprentice Merchant
apps.short_description: To pay for her childhood friend’s medical treatment, Mikael — an aspiring merchant — works herself to the bone to save up enough money to open her own shop.

apps.name: Milfania
apps.short_description: Milfania is a story-driven visual novel blending romance, drama, and intrigue, where your choices shape relationships and determine the outcome of every encounter. Navigate a world of temptation, secrets, and power as you build connections and uncover the truth.

apps.name: Mind’s Judgment
apps.short_description: A first-person psychological horror game. You wake in a hotel whose hallways repeat endlessly, never quite the same. Inspect every object, decipher its clues, and unravel its puzzles while something stalks you from the shadows. What you unearth will shape the verdict that awaits you.

apps.name: Mine Ore Else
apps.short_description: Little robots, lost in an ancient mine. Dig through solid rock for gold and gems, haul it home in your base's cart, and knock the ore out of your rivals' hands. Nobody gets hurt. Everybody gets robbed. Play solo against bots, or online with up to 32 players.

apps.name: MineralMarket
apps.short_description: Back a mineral discovery before the market catches on. Trade shares in a single-player stock market sim where companies explore, drill and publish results. Study the evidence, weigh the risk and decide whether to buy, hold or get out. Could you be the one to make it big?

apps.name: Mini Crime City
apps.short_description: Welcome to Mini Crime City, a chaotic open-world crime sandbox where every bad idea can become a great story. Steal cars, take on criminal jobs, customize your character, and outrun the cops. Go it alone or cause mayhem with friends online.

apps.name: Minimalist Industry Tycoon
apps.short_description: Minimalist Farm Tycoon is a resource management game. Grow crops, raise livestock, research upgrades, build factories and produce goods. Turn a failing farm into a profitable business.

apps.name: Mobile Phone Seller
apps.short_description: Take over your father's debt-ridden phone shop and turn it into a global tech empire! Buy, repair, and sell over 100 legendary phones from the 2000s to the present day, expand your store into a massive tech hub, hire staff, and build a family of your own beyond the counter!

apps.name: Mom! I'm gonna be a black hole when I grow up!
apps.short_description: From dust to a black hole. Use gravity to gather resources and combine evolution paths and skills to grow your own celestial body. In this physics-based growth game, gather safely or shatter and devour larger planets to grow faster. Manage resources, choose when to fight, and shape your own build.

apps.name: Mondrayn
apps.short_description: Mondrayn is a grim JRPG with survival elements where dying doesn't mean the end of your suffering. Dig into the remnants of a dead world, exterminate monsters, craft your gear. Help yourself and other restless souls make their way to Anthrum.

apps.name: MONOMANIA
apps.short_description: Obsessive 3D games in one package. Journey through a world of magic, keep insects that move like the real thing, catch and evolve monsters, build robots from gacha parts, and let a bullied boy's rage explode. One game. Many worlds. More arriving in Early Access.

apps.name: Moonlit Dreams
apps.short_description: A sokoban game with overlapping levels, inside a dreamscape you'll never want to leave. Push blocks, open doors, traverse mazes, and then do it again across and between three layers of psyche.

apps.name: MoonLit Journey: The Age of Deth
apps.short_description: Join us on an Epic Journey into the warped minds of life long gamers who are creating a nostalgic game, setting the player deep into a fantasy realm with a rich story line and many interactive features.

apps.name: Mop & Plot
apps.short_description: Clock in, clean up, and watch your back: in this chaotic online social deduction game for up to 12 players, paint walls, scrub floors, and finish the job while hidden Saboteurs wreak havoc. Use proximity voice chat to spot the culprits and vote them out!

apps.name: Most Games Flop
apps.short_description: You’re 12. It’s 2006. You’ve got the family laptop and one dream: make a hit on Studz. Plan every month, build games, chase the algorithm and survive copycats for 20 years. Most games flop. Try anyway. Then do it again with up to 7 friends online.

apps.name: Mostly Absurd Battle Simulator
apps.short_description: Wobbly physics battles. Place an army of farmers, knights, giants and a train with a face, press Launch and watch it all fall apart. Grab anyone and throw them off a cliff, or jump into a soldier and fight yourself.

apps.name: Mothville: A City of Hidden Things
apps.short_description: The residents of Mothville are always losing things and need the help of someone with eagle eyes! Explore the town’s diverse neighborhoods, talk to the animal residents, complete their quests, and find everything that’s gone missing in this wacky, story-driven hidden object game.

apps.name: Mount Tartarus
apps.short_description: Survive the underworld in Mount Tartarus, a bullet heaven roguelite. Cut through endless monster hordes and combine skills and passives into devastating builds. Every run earns gold for permanent upgrades, so each death makes you stronger. Besides, where else would you go? You are already dead.

apps.name: Mountain Goatastrophe
apps.short_description: Mountain Goatastrophe is a 1-4 player co-op climbing game where you play as mountain goats tied to one rope that wraps around everything. Jump gaps, avoid getting tangled, and reach the summit together. One bad step sends all of you back down the slope.

apps.name: Mr Police
apps.short_description: Patrol the streets, search suspicious trunks and put troublemakers behind bars in this first-person comedy police sim. Chase suspects, investigate crime scenes and hand out fines. Even Grandma isn't above the law. Your donut break will have to wait.

apps.name: Multiverse Survivors
apps.short_description: Unlock every universe, then field heroes and skills from different worlds together — dream matchups no history would allow. Einstein raises havoc in the Heavenly Court. Ancient generals hand-build an atom bomb. Odin opens fire with a gun. Sun Wukong fights aliens, and more.

apps.name: Murder in the Arctic Circle
apps.short_description: Murder in the Arctic Circle is a point-and-click exploration, photography and mystery adventure game in which the backgrounds are actual photos of real Norway - they were shot on location.

apps.name: My Beautiful Aquarium
apps.short_description: A fish tank that lives on your screen. Real species, and every fish is an individual you can name. In Cozy mode nothing can die, so you can leave it running all day. Challenge mode is proper fishkeeping: water types, breeding, sickness, mistakes. Play it, or just let it swim.

apps.name: My Crazy Stupid Pong Life
apps.short_description:
One summer, one paddle, and a megacorp that wants every court in the city...

Life gets weird when every problem is settled over Ping Pong.

apps.name: My Little Dino Den
apps.short_description: A cozy pixel-art desktop companion. Hatch eggs, name your baby dinos and raise them in a little den on your screen while you work. Feed, pet and tuck them in, then send them into turn-based battles, solo or as a pack of three, to unlock new species and face the dragons.

apps.name: My Time at Evershine
apps.short_description: Be the Governor of a brand-new settlement on the fringes of the Free Cities, facing the almighty Duvos Empire. Recruit settlers, build infrastructure, tame the wilds, and lead your people to become a new cornerstone for the Alliance in this adventure-packed simulation RPG!

apps.name: Nail Studio
apps.short_description: Run your own nail salon in Nail Studio, a cute and cozy nail art sim! Sculpt, paint, and blend gorgeous colors, then go totally extra with stamps, sparkly gems, and dangling charms. Give your clients the nails their hearts desire, then snap a pic of your fabulous creations.

apps.name: Naked Pursuit
apps.short_description: Naked Pursuit is an adults-only tropical chase game inspired by reality television. Track, capture, and outsmart unique contestants while climbing the leaderboard in a fast-paced island competition.

apps.name: NEET
apps.short_description: Alone on Halloween? How pathetic. Learn and choose how to live your sorry life, talk to a series of surreal visitors and witness the unspeakable in this highly interactive, soulful and atmospheric life simulator.

apps.name: Neon Dystopia
apps.short_description: Raid the underbelly of Neon Dystopia with your crew. Grab all the loot and extract! Or die and lose it all... A co-op synthwave/cyberpunk extraction roguelike.

apps.name: Neon Sword
apps.short_description: Neon Sword is an open world 3rd person top down action roleplay game. The non-linear story has multiple choices that effect the world around you leading you down many paths; the person you become is shaped by your decisions made within the game.

apps.name: Netherborn
apps.short_description: Become the embodiment of demonic fury in Netherborn, a fast-paced roguelite where you play as Lucius,the son of the Devil himself. Rip through hordes of twisted Furia creatures,unleash and evolve hellish abilities and carve your way through an endless onslaught in a world that refuses to let you go.

apps.name: Nine Winters
apps.short_description: Survive a ruined city where the infected lurk in Nine Winters. Fight back or slip through the dark to scavenge ruins yourself for parts and collectibles. Repair your broken shelter, grow crops, and decorate your home with cherished finds to endure nine winters.

apps.name: Ninth Hell
apps.short_description: Humanity is dying. The answers lie centuries in the past. In this dark fantasy action RPG, hunt the source of corruption across six eras. Shape and master your build, discover rare loot and follow the trail beyond Heaven’s gates into the nine depths of Hell. Uncover what humanity tried to bury.

apps.name: No Refunds
apps.short_description:
A 1–4 player co-op party game about running a live home-shopping show. 
Test mystery products backstage, then sell them on air with bold claims. 
Lie to boost sales, dodge the buzzer, and survive the returns, cats and chaos that follow.

apps.name: No Shot
apps.short_description: Launch into a zero-gravity arena and execute with your team in a fast-paced and intense sport only possible in virtual reality.

apps.name: No Touch.
apps.short_description: Guide your mouse cursor through moving walls, spinning bars and orbiting hazards. Read the warning, spot a safe opening and move before it closes. One touch ends the attempt in this single-player precision game.

apps.name: Nobody Survives
apps.short_description: A psx/ps1-style horror game telling the story about Bane, a former construction worker whose brother has gone missing. As a sequel of the game "Error 2351", search through old case files, talk to the residents, face the so-called "test subjects" and uncover the truth about scientist Jake Kron.

apps.name: NodeFeat
apps.short_description: Still reading? The black tide is back. No bones, no end. You don't build a base: you grow one, a mutant tree of concrete and steel, hungry for death. Order its branches, rewrite the ground, grind them to paste. There is no future. There is the wall.

apps.name: None Left To Hear It
apps.short_description: Imagine waking up and being the last human on earth, the world is no longer yours... now, it belongs to them...

apps.name: Nordic Sprint
apps.short_description: A classic-style cross-country skiing game where technique, stamina and drafting decide the race. Climb the World Cup with 20 abilities, race sprint, biathlon and relay in changing weather and wind – solo or in online multiplayer with up to 12 players.

apps.name: Nostos
apps.short_description: A mint-tin sci-fi survival horror dungeon crawler involving dice, cards and nerve. Generate nailbiting stories in short runs that fit around your life. Lead a salvage crew through a derelict stalked by a predatory Endoparasite. Push your luck, scavenge to survive, and reach the evac in one piece.

apps.name: Now You're Cooking
apps.short_description: A roguelike deckbuilder about running your own restaurant. Cook delicious meals, build an extravagant menu, and keep your patrons happy. Did I mention that rent doubles every month?

apps.name: NS Drive Simulator
apps.short_description: A driving simulator featuring realistic driving, diverse vehicles, and multiple driving environments.

apps.name: NTR Novels - The Elf Next Solstice
apps.short_description:
A cheeky adult Christmas visual novel. Goblins have seized Santa's Domain, and your elf girlfriend has her own way of dealing with them.
Pick the plan before every door: fight, distract or let her negotiate alone… then wait outside and wonder what's taking so long.

apps.name: Oasis Realms
apps.short_description: Explore, gather resources, and build in Oasis Realms, a colorful 3D sandbox. Shape the world block by block, create your own structures, and play solo or join online multiplayer to build and explore with others.

apps.name: Oddinary Farm
apps.short_description: Stuck on an alien TV show where your death is entertainment, you must escape a bizarre island filled with riches and deadly creatures before impending doom consumes you.

apps.name: Oddments & Offerings
apps.short_description: A first-person shopkeeper extraction game where you run a mysterious antique store by day and explore dangerous locations by night in search of rare and valuable oddities. Extract with your loot, grow your shop and decide what is worth selling - and what is worth keeping.

apps.name: Okey Dokey
apps.short_description: The tile-rummy roguelite. Lay runs and groups, outplay a rival at every table and stack boosts with regulars, drinks and enchanted tiles on a tour of the world's tile clubs, from Lisbon to the Grand Salon.

apps.name: OKTORAID
apps.short_description: Survive the AI robot uprising, solo or with a friend on one couch. Scavenge scrap, build a turret fortress, then auto-blast endless hordes in a roguelite siege, while the live power cable that ties you together fries every robot that crosses it.

apps.name: On The Hook
apps.short_description: You owe the casino boss a debt you can never repay—one that snowballs with compounding interest, growing heavier by the night. Several young female agents, themselves ensnared in the trap, are ready to take your orders. Make it out of the casino before the debt buries you alive.

apps.name: One Bow Army
apps.short_description: One archer against an undead army. Choose where every arrow lands, build your power through a skill tree, and hold the wall against the horde.

apps.name: One More Jackpot!
apps.short_description: Your arcade is dying. Nobody comes in. So you play every machine yourself. An active arcade incremental: smash, upgrade, wire it up, hit the JACKPOT!

apps.name: One More Wave: Tower Defense
apps.short_description: A tower defense game where you build towers along a road and hold off one wave after another. There are 9 towers with two upgrade paths each, 17 enemy types, 5 final bosses, 7 hand-made maps plus random ones, and an Endless mode.

apps.name: Orcs Must Die! Unchained
apps.short_description: Orcs Must Die! Unchained takes the award-winning Orcs Must Die! action tower defense game to a whole new level with team-based gameplay! Bust skulls with your best pals in PvE co-op Survival, or put your teamwork to the real test in Sabotage Mode!

apps.name: Order of the Jarl
apps.short_description: Answer the Jarl's summons and wield magic and blades in shifting dungeons to rescue the Right Hand from the Archdruid. In this first-person dungeon crawler, delve into '90s-inspired combat, loot items, face strange creatures, and unforeseen danger in a roguelike world where death = starting over.

apps.name: Our campus life
apps.short_description:
Our campus life is an AVG set against the backdrop of modern university life.
In an alternate contemporary world, players step into the shoes of the protagonist and experience a story where sports, friendship, and even romance intertwine with multiple characters.

apps.name: Out of the Park Baseball 22
apps.short_description: Play What The Pros Play! Officially licensed by MLB, MiLB, and the MLBPA, Out of the Park Baseball 22 is the newest in the award-winning strategy series. Fun, authenticity, and depth make it a sports fan’s dream come true - and the only game ever to win Metacritic PC Game of the Year Award TWICE.

apps.name: Outbreak: Type Z
apps.short_description: Your keyboard is the gun. Type to drop zombies in an isometric city that rebuilds every run. A story campaign, LAST STAND horde survival and an endless mode, with deadly special infected. Don't want to type? Play it as a shooter.

apps.name: Outlaw Raiders
apps.short_description: Lead your outlaw crew on raids to rob, steal, and fight for riches. Build up your camp and recruit more outlaws so you can become the ultimate outlaw.

apps.name: P.R.O.V.O.Z. the First Incident
apps.short_description: Going to work is a nightmare in itself. In this survival horror game set in oppressive Eastern Bloc bureaucracy, multitask through frantic factory maintenance, terminal commands, and camera monitoring to survive your first shift and fulfill the Ministry's quotas.

apps.name: PaleBlueRose
apps.short_description: Pale Blue Rose is a free-to-play online medieval city builder with real-time war. Grow a town from a founding wagon, master production chains, trade with up to 10,000 players and conquer rivals on one seamless world. Win by reaching 90% of the world's yearly economy.

apps.name: Pay to Think
apps.short_description:
An incremental game centered on intelligence as its core asset.

Once, humanity became the master of the Earth by virtue of its intelligence;

now, intelligence has found a new master.

Intelligence no longer belongs to the smartest humans—it belongs to whoever possesses it.

apps.name: Peekaboom
apps.short_description: A chaotic multiplayer battle royale where standing still makes you invisible. Hide, ambush and outsmart your enemies to become the last one standing!

apps.name: Pencil Shavings Soup
apps.short_description: Pencil Shavings Soup is an incremental about running an underground factory that makes soup from pencil shavings! Collect, sharpen and upgrade your way to becoming the richest critter ever!

apps.name: PET HUMAN
apps.short_description: Your livestock have human faces. Your customers have animal heads. Run a cursed farm, fulfil unsettling orders, and keep $300 by 5 AM. Buy weapons from a sinister merchant and uncover what waits beneath the farm in this first-person horror game.

apps.name: Phylactery Slayer
apps.short_description: A soulslike roguelike where every pixel of the world is destructible. Play solo, with your team, or face invading enemy squads. Four online modes, from solo runs to PvP arena. Each death leaves a phylactery that remembers your power.

apps.name: Pinetrail
apps.short_description: Deliver packages across Pinetrail in an overloaded rusty rickshaw truck! Meet the locals, uncover mysteries, and explore beautiful hidden spots. Use your vehicle's unique abilities to cross rivers, glide over trees, and battle cargo-stealing boars!

apps.name: PiPu Party
apps.short_description:
PiPu Party is a chaotic puzzle action game. 
Share a magic symbol bag to reshape the entire level in real time. 
No single 'correct' way to play it. 
2 player co-op & 2-8 player competitive chaos party.

apps.name: PitchMates
apps.short_description: Top-down online football with your mates. Up to 3v3 with real physics: thread a pass, bump a defender off the ball, or put your laces through it. Play casual rooms, climb ranked seasons, run your own leagues and cups, and earn every cosmetic just by playing. Free to play, nothing for sale.

apps.name: Pixel Imperium
apps.short_description: Create a world, watch it live. Or take matters into your own hands. Generate, draw, or import a real map, on land or among the stars. Customize it, painting its resources, realms, and peoples. Then watch history unfold, guide it in god mode, or lead a faction to glory yourself.

apps.name: Planar Robit
apps.short_description: An turn-based indie paper RPG taking place in the world of sentient machines. An amnesiac young robit and his new friends set out to discover his past and uncover the secrets of the world.

apps.name: Plunder: Scourge of the Sea
apps.short_description: Sign on with up to three friends, take a ship out of the haven and work her by hand. Fight the Scourge's dead with cutlass and pistol, board privateers, dive wrecks, dig up treasure, fish, gamble in the tavern and bring the plunder home to share. Empty berths fill with hired hands.

apps.name: Poli City
apps.short_description: Build a beautiful town, run its economy and services, win its votes and stay in power. Every train line, tax and law moves your voters, and they decide whether you keep the keys to Town Hall, or whether you refuse to hand them back.

apps.name: Pollox
apps.short_description: Grow from microscopic voxels to stellar scale in a vast procedural universe. Command dynamic swarms of billions of nanomachines, infect and reclaim matter, research new capabilities, and split into specialized forms in this solo or online co-op incremental sandbox.

apps.name: Pool of Madness
apps.short_description:
A horror pool roguelite with upgradable cues, guns and procedural rituals.
Shoot some balls. Unleash horrors from beyond. Go insane. Try again.

apps.name: Portal Reloaded
apps.short_description: Portal Reloaded is a free, community made modification for Portal 2. The mod builds on the concepts of the main game by allowing you to place a third portal, which enables traveling between two different timelines. Thinking in four dimensions is vital to solving 25 brand new mind-bending puzzles.
