apps.name: Portal: System Failure
apps.short_description: Portal: System Failure is an upcoming fan-made mod that expands upon the Portal universe with all-new puzzles and a darker narrative, all to deliver an epic singleplayer campaign. This new, full-length campaign will feature a carefully crafted story with new characters, and a unique soundtrack.

apps.name: Posted Missing
apps.short_description: A detective game at a London newspaper's shipping desk in 1876, where owners sink their own ships for the insurance. Work out what became of each ship, choose what the morning paper prints and get your family to America alive.

apps.name: Power Washing: Bear Cemetery
apps.short_description: Take over the care of Bear Hollow’s overgrown cemetery. Wash weathered headstones, mow the grass, and bring a little peace to its residents. Your predecessor left you the tools for the job—but looking after this place means more than keeping it tidy.

apps.name: PP Inflation
apps.short_description: PP INFLATION is an idle/incremental game, paying tribute to classic arcade games. Instead of controlling a paddle, you choose upgrades and optimize combinations to maximize your points-per-minute. Dial up the TIMESCALE skill to snowball through themed stages until victory.

apps.name: Project Confrontation
apps.short_description: Classic, squad-based combat. Players deploy into unforgiving environments, navigating firefights using precise coordination and mechanics. The game focuses entirely on true mechanical skill, raw situational positioning, and tight team coordination.

apps.name: Project Stampede
apps.short_description: Project Stampede is a fast-paced arcade racer where aggression is progression. Choose a vehicle, from dirt bikes to monster trucks, and rip it up around the globe in the most insane off-road racing league on earth. Race, wreck, and battle your way to become the top driver in the Stampede Festival!

apps.name: Psychose
apps.short_description:
Try the new experience Psychose horror game.
Sneak around to complete puzzles without getting caught, paid attention to the noises, to the lights.

apps.name: Pteranodon 2: Primal Island
apps.short_description: A first-person adventure packed with intense spear-throwing combat, ferocious dinosaurs, and thrilling pirate action! Arm yourself with a musketoon, hurl molotovs, and navigate a lush prehistoric world teeming with danger. Gameplay Time: 3-7 hours

apps.name: Pull Over!
apps.short_description: A co-op detective horror game set at a roadside militia checkpoint in 1991. Check papers, search cars and make quota by morning. Some of the drivers aren't human. Spot them and shoot first

apps.name: Purefire Life Stream
apps.short_description: PUREFIRE: Life Stream is a first-person psychological horror game set in New York City. Explore an immersive and terrifying experience, from Times Square to the quiet isolation of a luxurious penthouse high above the streets. As the livestream unfolds, buried memories give way to a waking nightmare.

apps.name: Quantum Go
apps.short_description: Go beyond one possible move. Quantum Go brings superposition and entanglement to the classic board game. Play online, explore uncertain positions, and discover how one collapse can change the whole board.

apps.name: Quit Stalin
apps.short_description: Stalin's on your couch, and one wrong word sends you and your family to the gulag. Get inside his head before he decides you're the problem. Freud, Adler, Jung - pick your psychological method. A dark comedy about therapy, power, and what it costs to tell a tyrant the truth.

apps.name: Racing The Beam
apps.short_description: Racing The Beam: How long can you stand? 20-track oval series on CyberVGA.

apps.name: Radar Shadow
apps.short_description: Somewhere on the other half of the map is the enemy's base. You don't know which hex it's on, and they don't know where yours is. No soldiers to click on: you run a country's radars, air defence and drone strikes, and design every drone and missile yourself.

apps.name: Ragdoll Ranch
apps.short_description: Raise chickens, rabbits, pigs, and cows on the most chaotic ranch you’ve ever seen. Expand your operation solo or bring a friend in this challenging FPS farming simulator.

apps.name: RAICER
apps.short_description: FPV drone racing and freestyle with real flight physics and a Betaflight-style flight controller. Fly eight drones or rebuild your real quad, race 20 maps, build your own maps and tracks, share it all on Steam Workshop and chase times on the Steam leaderboards.

apps.name: Raisin Universe
apps.short_description: Your stream chat is the controller. Viewers play Minefield, Sudoku, Crossword, Marble Race and more by typing in Twitch or TikTok chat. Play 16 minigames on their own, or run a full board game with three boards.

apps.name: Ramen Shop in the Floating Slums
apps.short_description: Start penniless in a floating slum. Scavenge for supplies, choose from dozens of ingredients to create your own ramen, and grow your shop in this first-person ramen shop and life sim. Earn money and build your reputation, go fishing, and explore a city created just for this game.

apps.name: Ramen://protocol
apps.short_description:
🍜🃏 Ramen://protocol is a cyberpunk ramen-stall roguelite deckbuilder.
Push your toppings to their limits, then rev them up even further with skills.
Master countless synergies and serve bowls so good they're synapse-frying.
Chase the one bowl that will cut you free from your past.

apps.name: Rapid Escalation
apps.short_description: A fast-paced incremental space shooter where short battles fuel permanent upgrades and exponential growth.

apps.name: Rat Hunt
apps.short_description: A chaotic multiplayer party game: a swarm of tiny rats must outlast hungry hawks in a giant backyard. The twist? Moving gives you away, so freeze to vanish in the grass. Whisper to friends with proximity voice... if you dare. Get caught and you JOIN the hunt.

apps.name: Ravenfield: Multiplayer Mod
apps.short_description: That's right folks! Ravenfield now has its very own community-curated multiplayer mode! RFMP is a community project with the sole goal of bringing multiplayer to Ravenfield. You can now join in the multiplayer PvP mayhem with your Eagle (or Raven) Allies to eliminate those pesky Ravens (or Eagles)!

apps.name: Raze The Realm
apps.short_description: Lead massive armies in large-scale battles in this real-time tactics roguelite. Build your army, discover powerful relic synergies, and choose your path through a realm that grows more dangerous with every victory.

apps.name: Rebel Roar
apps.short_description: Build two decks at once in REBEL ROAR, a tactical deckbuilding roguelike where each rebel unlocks a different way to play. Combine an animal deck with a class deck to create Ninja Cats, Hacker Opossums, and hundreds of unique builds as you lead the rebellion through a cyberpunk animal world.

apps.name: Red Eye Empire
apps.short_description: Build a global airline from a single prop-plane. Your planes fly real routes on a living globe and keep earning while you're away. Grow hubs, unlock new regions, then sell your airline and start a holding company of subsidiaries. A relaxing idle tycoon that lives on your desktop.

apps.name: Redacted by the Sadistic Princess from Another World?!
apps.short_description: Socially awkward game developer Yaemori Nowa receives more than she bargains for when two characters she created for her indie smash hit eroge, Utter Obedience: Conquered by the Sadistic Princess, appear in her apartment. What's a hopeless lesbian to do?!

apps.name: Reel Bad Fishing
apps.short_description: A washed-up fisherman, a debt to a mermaid, and an island chain full of gangs, gamblers and sea monsters. Fish with traps, sonar and a revolver, scratch off tickets for legendary catches, and shoot, scheme and gamble your way to the top of the worst sea in the world.

apps.name: Remains on the bus
apps.short_description: Every passenger could be a shapeshifter. You are a bus driver who must let ordinary passengers board while identifying and kicking out shapeshifters hiding among them.

apps.name: Resources Assemble!
apps.short_description: Build, automate, and expand your factory. Mine resources, craft components, and evolve your systems toward full autonomy and interplanetary production

apps.name: Rest Stop
apps.short_description: Alone at a highway rest stop in the middle of the Appalachian Mountains, the night breeze begins to caress your cheek. The scent of wet pine whispers that you’re home. The taste of iron in your mouth reminds you that you can’t stay here forever.

apps.name: Retro Fútbol
apps.short_description: Retro Fútbol is a football management game inspired by the classics of the 1990s. Manage your squad, transfers, tactics, stadium, and finances, and lead your club to the top season after season.

apps.name: Retro Party
apps.short_description: Nostalgia for '90s games: 25+ mini-games in a single party. Play online with up to 8 people, or 4 on the same screen. Every game is its own kind of chaos: racing, shooting, a battle of wills, and plenty more. A chance to relive the good old days with your friends.

apps.name: Revenge Crystal Project
apps.short_description: Awaken in a fallen knight’s body, kept alive by a mysterious living crystal. Explore a ruined world with top-down Soulslike combat, elemental magic, and Metroidvania progression. You are not the knight—you are the will driving him.

apps.name: Reverse TD
apps.short_description: A tower defense where your towers don't shoot enemies, they make your own army stronger. Add runes, draft cards with upsides and downsides, and permanent unlocks between runs. Co-op with up to 4 players or free-for-all with up to 8.

apps.name: RIGGED2EXPLODE
apps.short_description: A tactical shooter where running out of bullets sets off a bomb strapped to your chest. Sneak through levels, take out enemies, and use the environment to your gain the advantage. Take your time and make every bullet count.

apps.name: ROBOSCAV
apps.short_description: ROBOSCAV is a turn-based extraction RPG where you command fully customizable robots into raids. Explore the planet, Scavenge for loot, Fight robots and aliens, Extract. After crash landing on a hostile planet, you must rebuild your spaceship from scratch, to escape.

apps.name: Rock and Found
apps.short_description: Your Grandma has willed you a collection of rocks deep in the woods, but when you arrive, you find that the rocks are strewn across the floor. Armed with your Grandma's journal, a determination to clean the collection, and the tools she left behind, you begin sorting through thousands of rocks.

apps.name: RockIt Ronnie
apps.short_description: Strap on a rocket pack and deliver the ridiculous. Thrust, coast and dodge through lively harbors, sandstone canyons, chaotic factories and neon festivals. Keep your cargo intact, chain risky pickups, upgrade your gear and earn delivery challenge stamps.

apps.name: Rogue's Cog
apps.short_description: A steampunk bubble-shooter roguelike. Load the cannon. Match the color. The ceiling drops. Nine mutations to level, one score to take, no second run — until you or the tower is done.

apps.name: RogueBlocks
apps.short_description: Stack rows, unleash powerful combos, and survive Chaos that rewrites the rules—solo or with friends—in this comic-inspired roguelite puzzle adventure.

apps.name: Rolling Front
apps.short_description: A real-time strategy game about building your kingdom of rolling balls and destroying the enemies.

apps.name: Rotten Keep
apps.short_description: Trapped in a medieval castle while investigating a deadly plague, Maestro Severino must survive the unholy horrors stalking its halls. Hide, solve sinister puzzles, and rescue the count’s surviving daughter before the nightmare claims you both in this survival stalker horror game.

apps.name: Round Table Rivals
apps.short_description: Round Table Rivals is a turn-based fighting game where your strategy starts the combo — but your timing keeps it alive. Build your team, chain attacks, take down powerful bosses, and challenge your friends in head-to-head battles.

apps.name: RSP Ultimate Battle
apps.short_description: Rock-paper-scissors meets strategic card autobattling! Collect and merge cards, build your team, and outsmart opponents through positioning, elemental matchups, unique abilities, and spells.

apps.name: Runes & Revenue
apps.short_description: Welcome to the enchanting world of magic retail! Runes & Revenue is a cozy, hands-off management game where you manage your own magic shop. Recruit staff, unlock new mystical services. Strategically purchase upgrades to keep up with customer demand and ensure every adventurer leaves happy.

apps.name: Rush & Command
apps.short_description: Rush & Command is a classic multiplayer real time strategy game, that will intrigue both highly tactical as well as casual RTS players. The game is set in an alternate world where units and armies dating back from the 1960-1980 are enriched with high-tech current technologies and knowledge.

apps.name: Rúnafall
apps.short_description: A retro-styled co-op action roguelike in Viking-age Norway. Raid as one of five black-metal Vikings, carve through draugr, trolls and corpse-ravens, and topple the monsters who rule three cursed regions, to an original industrial metal score by Norway's Melt Motif. Solo or with up to three friends.

apps.name: S.K.R.U.B. Squad
apps.short_description: Kick back, relax, and get cleaning solo or with friends! The multiverse is a messy place, and when things get dirty the S.K.R.U.B. Squad is there!

apps.name: Safe at Dawn
apps.short_description: Supernatural events are taking place throughout the night. Keep a close watch on all the rooms and don't overlook even the smallest detail. Try to make it through the night, either alone, with the help of other players, or by competing against them. Will you be safe at dawn?

apps.name: Sail On
apps.short_description: A stylized pirate roguelite with asynchronous run-based PVP, where you combine projectile properties to create devastating combos and dominate the seas even after your run ends. Die loud, rebuild louder and "Sail On"!

apps.name: SAMA
apps.short_description: A young girl lost in a dark forest must survive among terrifying creatures, harsh nature, and her own fear.

apps.name: Sanity Shooter
apps.short_description: A surreal boomer shooter where you fight through bizarre dimensions, master fast-paced combat, and adapt your tactics to survive increasingly dangerous encounters.

apps.name: Saratoma Vale
apps.short_description: Adult visual novel, real life situations with choices and consequences.

apps.name: Save Mr. Peachee
apps.short_description: Mr. Peachee is looking for love, but the world offers only death. Escort his train through a savage wilderness in a high-intensity third-person adventure. Fight solo or with up to 2 friends, upgrade your train and characters, and protect Mr. Peachee on his journey to his beloved.

apps.name: Save The Cat!
apps.short_description: A lost cat is waiting for you. Use your hand to shift the world, clear a path, and bring it home through 6 themed worlds and 120 handcrafted sliding puzzles. Avoid dogs, use boxes and portals, and keep your promise: this time, you will save the cat.

apps.name: Screenbreak
apps.short_description: Screenbreak is an action roguelike RPG set inside a corrupted computer system overrun by a dangerous virus. Fight through glitching programs, broken files, infected security systems, and unstable digital worlds as you uncover the truth behind the infection.

apps.name: Sea Of Rifts
apps.short_description: Captain an ironclad into a broken ocean in this naval sandbox RPG. Hire a crew of misfits with their own traits, grudges, and breaking points. Keep mutiny at bay and fight sea monsters under steam and sail. Every voyage leaves a story behind, if you live to tell it.

apps.name: Secret of Nox
apps.short_description: Immerse yourself in this action roguelike game, turn defeated enemies into your minions. Explore 12+ unique classes, endless playstyles, battle through 50+ maps, epic bosses and discover the Secret of Nox.

apps.name: Sepulcra
apps.short_description: Sepulcra is a unique combo-based dungeon crawler roguelike. Befriend unlikely allies and discover powerful combos to escape the Spiral. With a gorgeous, hand-drawn 2D look, explore this world of lost souls.

apps.name: Seven Nights at the Equator
apps.short_description: An adult romantic visual novel set during seven days in Singapore. Reconnect with old friends, make meaningful choices, build relationships, and explore four romantic routes. Your decisions shape the story and lead to one of 18 unique endings.

apps.name: Shadow Rush
apps.short_description: Slay hordes of Shadow Demons in this Action RPG with roguelike elements. Fast-paced combat, quick runs, build experimentation, and re-rolling characters. Spells are collectable, equip-able 'Shards' that trigger when you attack. CAN YOU BEAT THE SPEED OF DARKNESS?

apps.name: SHAKE ME ALICE!
apps.short_description: Grab your phone and swing your arm! In this online co-op action game for 1–4 players inspired by Alice’s Adventures in Wonderland, Alice and her friends must work together to escape after angering the Queen of Hearts. Run, jump and throw your way through a madcap adventure!

apps.name: shatAAAAp!
apps.short_description:
Exponentially bigger waves of cute animals require increasingly absurd means of destruction.
Shoot, burn, electrocute, explode... and make sure no one ever helps you.

apps.name: Shattered Dice of Fate
apps.short_description: Hold, reroll, and choose the hand that matters now. Grow from a Pioneer into your own class build across ten expeditions in this turn-based roguelite. Read enemy intent, time your skills, and turn the lessons of defeat into your next attempt.

apps.name: SHATTERFARMS
apps.short_description:
Farm. Forage. Fight. SHATTERFARMS is a first-person farmcore roguelike where you'll scavenge and fight through the Calamity, while cultivating a mysterious farm to survive and grow stronger. Creatures are untamed, magic unstable, and horrors unimaginable.
Welcome to SHATTERFARMS.

apps.name: Shelf Therapy
apps.short_description: Shelf Therapy is a relaxing first-person 3D shelf-organizing game. Pick up everyday products and place them freely in their designated sections. Arrange drinks, snacks, ready-to-eat meals, and more without fixed slots, and enjoy turning empty shelves into neat displays.

apps.name: Shield Operator 2
apps.short_description: You are an air defense operator. Night falls, sirens wail, and radar detects drones, missiles, and bombers. Every miss costs a home or a power grid. Hold the line, save your missiles, then strike back: launch your jets and crush enemy positions. The city remembers every strike.

apps.name: Shipmaxxing
apps.short_description: Your ship shoots on its own, you just steer. Blast through 45 second runs, haul back scrap and grow a 145 node upgrade tree until one tiny ship becomes a screen filling bullet storm.

apps.name: Shipping Away
apps.short_description: Drowning in student debt, you take a job at your local post office. Customers hand you items to pack and envelopes to ship, while every shift brings new rules and a clock that never stops ticking. Pack boxes, beat the line, and wipe out your student debt in this time management job sim.

apps.name: Shire Scopes
apps.short_description: A multiplayer arena shooter with sniper-muskets, swords, and fluid movement mechanics. Climb the leaderboards!

apps.name: Shuffle Bistro
apps.short_description: Mix menus and build facilities to hit daily revenue goals. Create brand new synergy builds every run with 100+ types of facilities and 4 distinct theme perks in this restaurant deck-building roguelike.

apps.name: Shutterbug Skies: Idle Camping
apps.short_description: A cozy corner idler built to be your daily desktop companion. Help Kes search for and photograph beautiful bugs while you work, study, or relax. Upgrade your camera equipment, complete your creature collection, and discover 7 unique floating islands!

apps.name: Siege Protocol
apps.short_description: Siege Protocol is a multiplayer first-person melee combat game where robots clash in team-based battles and competitive game modes. Fight with melee weapons and abilities, take control of objectives, and customize your robot.

apps.name: Singularity Rising
apps.short_description: A hand-drawn 2D physics-destruction shooter set in the first hours of an AI uprising. You are an old lighthouse keeper with a shotgun. Enemies are mechanisms, not health bars: every leg, brace and armour plate you break changes how the machine fights.

apps.name: SisterFall
apps.short_description: On the witch's request, the nun Agnès sinks deeper into the ancient ruins. An R18 pixel-art exploration action game. Caught by monsters, her clothes tear on the spot as she is defiled. Over 70 lewd scenes. Corruption drags her down, and at times she offers herself to monsters and lewd tools...

apps.name: Sit or Die
apps.short_description:
Music plays, chairs appear. Lie, cooperate, deceive. 
In a closed cylinder, up to 12 players face unpredictable survival rounds. Find a chair or be eliminated. It's more than a chair—it involves rules, order, perception, and lies. Who will you trust, and who is deceiving you?

apps.name: Sitback Saga
apps.short_description:
An idle party ARPG where you sit back and watch your heroes explore the world, clear dungeons, and complete side quests.
Equip & upgrade your party, set their tactics, and cast spells yourself to turn the tide of battle.

apps.name: Slice Overdrive
apps.short_description: Slice Overdrive is a precision platformer built on speed, control, and flawless execution. Carve through deadly player-built levels, claim leaderboard glory, and ride the retro-synth soundtrack as you chase that perfect run.

apps.name: Slutopia
apps.short_description: Slutopia is a modern utopia centered around a luxurious dream villa! The most beautiful and liberated girls are waiting for you: an office siren, a sexy nurse, and other hot employees. Build your own debauched mansion and form the tightest relationships with your subordinates!

apps.name: Snake Echos
apps.short_description: "Snake Echos: your trail hardens into deadly walls. Loop enemies into your own path, level up with Magnet/Fireball/Scythe abilities, survive escalating chaos with blocks and lasers. Solo leaderboard + Duel mode. 3 difficulty tiers.

apps.name: Snake With Bird
apps.short_description: This project has currently ceased development. If we restart the project later, we will notify everyone on the Steam page and social media accounts.

apps.name: Solaro
apps.short_description: Explore space like an alien. Solaro is an experimental adventure game where you guide a tiny traveller through a vast galaxy of puzzles and trials.

apps.name: Sorcerous 2 City of Cults
apps.short_description: Kick down doors, hunt sinister cults, and face bloodthirsty gods in a dark diesel-punk metropolis. Lead a group of magic-school students into turn-based battles with carefully chosen spells, talismans, and occult weapons.

apps.name: Sort the Magic Potions: Tidy Up and Shelve
apps.short_description: Cozy single-player organizing and cleaning simulator where you sort 3,040 scattered potions throughout a mysterious magical library. Return every potion to its proper shelf, organize magical collections by type, unlock powerful abilities, restore perfect order, and reveal the way out.

apps.name: Souls on the Line
apps.short_description: Become a Spirit Summoner and lead an army of Souls in this tactical roguelike deckbuilder. Collect strange entities with unique abilities and lead them in position- and sequence-based combat. Thwart the plans of a kingdom obsessed with dark magic by stealing their sinister Artifact.

apps.name: Souq Boss Simulator
apps.short_description: Every Sheikh-sized fortune has to start somewhere. Yours starts with a tiny baqala. Manage your shop, meet the locals, build your fortune, and invest across a 2002 Gulf city inspired by Old Dubai & Riyadh. Solo or with friends in online co-op. Become the Souq Boss.

apps.name: Space Catnips
apps.short_description: Space Catnips is an incremental game where you harvest catnips from alien planets and showcase them in your bar to attract a wide variety of space cats!

apps.name: Space Cooking Simulator
apps.short_description: Run your own space restaurant as an astronaut chef. Cook burgers, hot dogs, wraps, and fries, serve aliens and astronauts, hire robot assistants, unlock new equipment, and grow your small kitchen into a thriving galactic culinary empire.

apps.name: Space Nanny
apps.short_description: A chaotic sci-fi multitasking game where minigames share controls and an alien baby keeps pressing the wrong buttons. Juggle multiple challenges, fling the baby away, and undo its mischief before alarms, smoke, and blackouts overwhelm your board. Remember: Never let him press the big red button!

apps.name: Speedway Team Manager
apps.short_description: Take charge of a British speedway club in a detailed management simulation. Sign riders, negotiate contracts, tune bikes, manage finances and make tactical race-day decisions. Watch the action unfold in 2D or 2.8D as you chase league and cup glory across multiple seasons.

apps.name: Spektr
apps.short_description: Spektr is an asymmetrical online horror game where the objective is simple, haunt or be hunted. Enter a multidimensional battle with up to 4 friends. One of you will randomly be selected to become a ghost, and the rest of you will have to track down and expel the ghost from the physical realm.

apps.name: Spiriki: Tiny Island
apps.short_description: Listening to the gentle sound of the waves, take care of three small quirky nature spirits! With their help and some patience, create your own tiny cozy diorama and bring back life to your overgrown island!

apps.name: Starbreaker
apps.short_description: Prospect a procedurally generated, infinite galaxy in this open-world space mining and combat sandbox. Carve ore from fully voxel based asteroids, outfit your ship, hunt bounties, and build your fortune! You can even bring a friend, or a few, in online (or LAN, up to you!) co-op/multiplayer!

apps.name: StarFaction
apps.short_description: A roguelike space fleet builder. Expand your fleet, fight epic space battles against rival factions, and capture their planets. Discover countless insane builds and break the game to conquer the galaxy.

apps.name: Starfuse
apps.short_description: The stars went out, and then the Sun. Launch fireworks into the night, pop drifting wish lanterns and set off chains across the sky. Every wish you free relights a star, until you are strong enough to rekindle the Sun itself. A cozy, punchy fireworks incremental.

apps.name: Starpath
apps.short_description: Build your starship alone or with friends and explore a seamless universe. Plot a course, burn your thrusters, and chill out in your retro tech ship while you play games and drift through the dangerous vacuum of space. Approach orbit around distant worlds to discover whether we are truly alone.

apps.name: Steal Deal
apps.short_description: Embark on a 2D Roguelike adventure across an ending world, alone or with friends! Explore randomly generated levels, enhance your character, and seek the Divine Deals in this action-packed game!

apps.name: Stellar Overload
apps.short_description:
Robots invaded the peaceful planet Merx. Go on an adventure to free your world from them.

Stellar Overload is a 3D open-world, blocks-based, FPS, adventure game.

apps.name: Stellar Swing 2
apps.short_description: Launch, grapple and swing a tiny drone through bright alien skies. Surf planets, grind rails, slingshot round moons and chase your fastest run.

apps.name: STEP THEATER
apps.short_description:
WELCOME TO THE “STEP THEATER” :) 
“STEP THEATER” is a vibrant rhythm game where the story unfolds and the screen comes closer to success with every step you take. Dive in and enjoy this charming, vibrant drama!

apps.name: Stick Man Game
apps.short_description: Use physics-based contraptions to produce and deliver nutrient cubes. Each floor is different, providing new challenges along the way. Buy upgrades, use automated machines to increase productivity, and unlock new abilities as you descend.

apps.name: STICKMAN DESKTOP MALWARS
apps.short_description: A physics stickman brawler on a living computer desktop. The taskbar is the floor, windows are platforms and every app opens a new arena. Brawl as eight ragdoll fighters, each with their own attacks, or be the giant mouse cursor: charge a RAM, run VirusGuard on them and open a black hole.

apps.name: Still Awake
apps.short_description: Still Awake is a psychological horror game that puts you inside the terrifying experience of sleep paralysis, where you're trapped between sleep and reality.

apps.name: Still Wild
apps.short_description: Step into quiet living worlds where endangered and extinct animals still move freely through forests, oceans, and wild places untouched by time.

apps.name: Stillwater: Coastal Maine
apps.short_description: Make yourself at home on the Maine coast. Explore an old captain's house, read by the window, fish from the dock, and look for sea glass along the tide line. Choose the season, weather, and time of day, or watch a storm come in off the Atlantic. A quiet place to return to at your own pace.

apps.name: StormEdge: Wind of Change
apps.short_description: Wind of Change is the first chapter of StormEdge, an action roguelite adventure. Dodge enemies' attacks, trigger deadly traps, and explore the captivating tale of Elemental Storms' origins. Brace for treacherous challenges and test your skills against the Tempests!

apps.name: Stormtide Skies
apps.short_description: Take command of a steam-powered airship and battle across the storm-torn skies. Fight solo, challenge AI, compete online, experience a cinematic story, or survive the relentless waves and colossal bosses of Redwake Siege.

apps.name: Stream Slayers
apps.short_description: Turn your Twitch chat into a party in Stream Slayers! Choose from 6 unique classes, level up, unlock powerful abilities, and work together to defeat increasingly powerful bosses. Your chat fights.

apps.name: Streamer Survivors
apps.short_description: Your chat showed up in person. Survive obsessive fans in a satirical action roguelite: combine streaming gear, unlock weapon evolutions and trigger elemental chain reactions. Eight streamers, seventeen weapons and four modes. Czech-language gameplay.

apps.name: Strike Commander
apps.short_description: It's 2011, you command Stern’s Wildcats, an elite squadron of mercenaries trying to fly straight in a world of deceit and violence. Pilot advanced aircraft as you engage rival squadrons and the armies of the dreaded IRS.

apps.name: Stuck On Me
apps.short_description: Everyone at the table can see the card stuck on your forehead. Everyone but you. Ask yes or no questions out loud, knock down the cards it can't be and guess first. A cozy, noisy party game for 2 to 8 friends with felt puppets and built in voice chat.

apps.name: Suffer Together
apps.short_description: A 2-player online co-op comedy horror game. Describe symbols to your partner and defend yourself against deadly animatronics to win Stella’s game show!

apps.name: Suits & Stallions
apps.short_description: Every midnight, the museum statues race across the card table. Whoever wins tonight gets the central spotlight in the main hall tomorrow morning. Flip two cards and pick one. The suit you choose moves forward. Even if it isn't yours.

apps.name: SUMOLYGONS
apps.short_description: Geometry with a grudge. A 1-4 player physics brawler where you win by shoving rivals out of the arena. No health bars. Just physics, skill & strategy. Pick a Shape with its own unique traits, combine abilities, discover their fusions, find your favorite combos, and build your own SUMOLYGON arenas!

apps.name: Sunbed Simulator
apps.short_description: Take over an unlicensed beach with a few sunbeds and become king of the coast! In this first-person business sim, serve guests, hire staff and grow your resort – solo or in online co-op with friends. Bribe the police and sabotage the hotel next door. On this beach, you make the rules!

apps.name: Sunny Trails
apps.short_description: Sunny Trails is a cozy turn-based RPG. Amaterasu and her sisters travel to a party on a paradisiacal Brazilian island, only to find all the guests turned to stone. Fish, decorate your camp, and explore the island to discover who petrified your friends!

apps.name: SUPER EXCITE BALL
apps.short_description: Smash incoming balls into your opponents' goals! A chaotic 1–4 player action game packed with special balls and wild arena gimmicks!

apps.name: Super Optimal Amount of Punching
apps.short_description: Punch everything. Learn nothing. Lord Evil's shining nipples await you.

apps.name: Super Piotr Deluxe
apps.short_description: Jump from platform to platform, survive enemy waves and defeat bizarre bosses as Piotr descends through giant toilet portals into an ever-stranger arcade universe guided, questioned and occasionally mocked by Peypi, his living toiletpaper companion.

apps.name: Super Slime
apps.short_description: A hardcore precision platformer with tight controls, smooth physics, and brutally challenging levels designed to test your skill.

apps.name: SuperCitycon
apps.short_description: A city builder with a retro-inspired look and the freedom to shape your world. Build roads, railways and entire neighborhoods in a creative sandbox. Customize buildings, vehicles and more with SCC Studio, the in-game voxel editor, and share your creations through Steam Workshop.

apps.name: SuperTrucks Multiplayer Racing
apps.short_description:
SuperTrucks is a competitive, real time, ranked multiplayer racing game. 
Race against real opponents on challenging track surfaces, upgrade your truck and rank up as you win races.

apps.name: Suspira
apps.short_description: SUSPIRA is an adult visual novel with puzzle elements in which you take the role of the degenerate and unrepentant villain from THE BOOK OF BONDMAIDS as she attempts to take over the wealthy merchant City of Dammeren.

apps.name: Sweet Succubus 2
apps.short_description: Sweet Succubus 2 - A simple and beautiful jigsaw puzzle game themed around succubi. Spend time with five beautiful and sexy succubi, accompanied by relaxing music. After completing a level, you can view the girl's photos in the gallery.

apps.name: Symloquy
apps.short_description: Meet Xuanxuan in Symloquy, a sound novel with AI dialogue. The Fading slowly erodes her memories and sense of self, while your conversations bring an Echo that helps her stay lucid. As you grow closer, discover her past and perhaps hear what she usually keeps to herself.

apps.name: SYNTAX WARS
apps.short_description: Both players pick a hidden move, then reveal at once — a duel of reads, not reflexes. Play solo: VS CPU, arcade, and challenge runs. Free demo (3 of 6 fighters). Strong, Weak, and Guard, plus signature moves and other actions. Play on the same screen, or online with Remote Play Together.

apps.name: System 95
apps.short_description: You are the mouse cursor. Shoot viruses, dodge system errors and turn desktop tools into weapons. Choose your next program, assemble a build and unlock permanent upgrades in a roguelite shooter inspired by 1990s computers.

apps.name: Take One Down
apps.short_description: Ninety-nine bottles of beer on the wall. You know how it goes. Take one down, pass it around, and keep the Singer company at the bar. He's sung this song more times than he can count, and lately it's starting to sound a little strange.

apps.name: Tempo Derby
apps.short_description: Tempo Derby is a timing-driven horse-racing roguelike. Hit the sweet spot, build powerful relic combinations and race through a 15-stage campaign. Unlock new horses, fuse legendary relics and outpace five bosses on your way to the championship.

apps.name: Tenshi's Teatime
apps.short_description: A cozy café simulation game where you plan menus, serve hand-animated characters, and decorate your teahouse in charming KAWAII styles. Earn your way to the top by impressing elite critics, unlocking new café looks, and upgrading your skills across a heartfelt story full of adorable characters.

apps.name: That's Not My Cat!
apps.short_description: Adopt a tiny cat that lives on top of your desktop. It hops across your windows, naps on your taskbar, and earns its hats one cuddle at a time. Name it. Love it. Never close it.

apps.name: THE BACKLOG
apps.short_description: A used-game shop after closing, its floor buried under 5,000+ games and consoles. Pick one up, read the label, and put it on its console's shelf until the shop is tidy. A first-person tidying sim with no timer and no game over. Get faster, find small rewards, and play with up to 3 friends.

apps.name: The Black Below
apps.short_description: Classic grid-based dungeon crawling, rebuilt: a 3D dungeon reduced to stylized one-bit art, a score synthesized live, automapping, skill trees, and a party whose dead stay on the roster. Under a city that lives off a hole in the ground, something is sleeping, and nobody agrees on what it is.

apps.name: The Christmas Shift
apps.short_description: The Christmas Shift is a cozy horror game where you work the holiday shift at a local café. Prepare hot drinks, serve fresh pastries, and keep your customers happy.

apps.name: The Death Night Show
apps.short_description: The Death Night Show is a narrative game with multiple endings and unlockable scenes where you play as Death's intern in his own late night show. Control the audience's reactions to the events of the program, run errands, and uncover the overarching mystery with each new featured guest.

apps.name: The Deep Waits
apps.short_description: You have one minute to live. Eat, explore, fight, and craft your way off a cursed island before the deep takes you.

apps.name: The Demon King's Reclusive Strategist
apps.short_description: To solidify the new Demon King's authority, violate the incoming heroes and broadcast their shameful, lust-broken submission for the entire world to see!

apps.name: The Dream Hold
apps.short_description: Hardcore turn-based RPG. Choose a soul fragment trapped in the dream world, travel between the shattered dreamscapes, search, explore, survive, build skills, fight, and find a way out.

apps.name: The Fable of a Rabbit
apps.short_description: WIP

apps.name: The Fatal Card
apps.short_description: A tactical 1v1 card duel in a dark fantasy world. 31 characters with their own skills: curses, diseases, undead summons, attacks across the whole board. Place your cards, exploit your opponent's weaknesses and beat the AI or real players in ranked Steam matches.

apps.name: The Final Stamp
apps.short_description: Papers, Please in the afterlife. Question the dead, uncover their sins with strange instruments, and decide: Hell, Heaven, or Purgatory. Even Johny Goldstein has a story that makes him innocent. Check it before you reach for the stamp.

apps.name: The Funskin Project
apps.short_description: A horrifying experience in a strange and timeless universe. Explore, solve puzzles, fight for your survival and try to escape this nightmare.

apps.name: The Infinite Box
apps.short_description: A fully animated adult life-sim where you manage time, earn money, explore, and unlock animated character events through choices, schedules, and relationship progression.

apps.name: The Last Delivery
apps.short_description: Working the night shift at a remote roadside diner was supposed to just pay the bills. Instead, you're thrown into a web of strange patrons, unsolved disappearances, and a shadowy serial killer. Search the dark. Solve the past. Survive the shift.

apps.name: The Last Exterminator
apps.short_description: You're an exterminator. You kill things for a living. When a hostile invasion of alien cockroaches rocks your city, you've got a job to do. A high-octane retro-FPS inspired by some of the best games of the 90s.

apps.name: The Last Iron Sentinel
apps.short_description: A first-person zombie roguelike shooter. Humanity is down to one last shelter, and you are its last sentinel robot. Mow through hordes of 100+ zombies, freeze time to draft upgrades, turn your bullets into fire, ice or lightning, and rip chainsaws and missile packs off elites to bolt onto yourself.

apps.name: The Little Cat Things
apps.short_description:
The Little Cat Things is a survival-themed role-playing game.
Players take on the role of a stray cat, forging friendships with all kinds of feline and canine companions as they struggle to survive in a forgotten corner of the city.

apps.name: The Little Cloud
apps.short_description: You’re a little cloud with a big job. Soar over the cozy seaside town of Peace Wind Bay as its newest sky courier: deliver parcels, give rides, and rain on the places that need it most. Make friends, bring wilted fields back to life, and on Rainbow Day, paint the sky for everyone.

apps.name: THE MONASTERY
apps.short_description: Do you miss classic survival horror games? Here you will find a classic mansion, riddles, a mysterious atmosphere and references to the good old games.

apps.name: The Old Circle: Ecos da Masmorra
apps.short_description: A pixel-art action RPG for 1 to 4 players. Choose one of five classes, master real-time combat, shape your build with glyphs, runes and 50 gear sets, and descend through 21 dungeons with their own deadly rules to face 21 bosses, solo or in online co-op.

apps.name: The Old Parish
apps.short_description: A cozy top down farming and life sim in a rural Irish parish. Clear and sow the family farm, raise cattle and sheep, fish the lake and cook Irish recipes. Chat with the neighbours after Sunday Mass and spend your evenings at O'Brien's over a pint and a hand of Twenty Five.

apps.name: The Orange of Tomorrow
apps.short_description:
The Orange of Tomorrow is a turn-based RPG where you must aim your attacks.
Use the power of fate and the elements to discover the meaning of love, oranges and what tomorrow holds.

apps.name: The Risen Survival
apps.short_description: The Risen Survival is an open-world survival game featuring intense PvE & PvP, base building, crafting, and relentless zombies. Gather resources, expand your base, fight for valuable loot, and compete with other players in a persistent online world

apps.name: The Salt Mine 3
apps.short_description: Steal the Salt and fight your way home in a free third-person fantasy action game for Windows. Pick from nine heroes, fight across three team battlegrounds, or meet friends in Saltwake and descend into the Lantern Vault together.

apps.name: The Singularity
apps.short_description: Face your friends in a futuristic/cyberpunk card game where each card unleashes a different kind of chaos. Manage to keep the Singularity in your hand until the end to be the winner. Establish the Singularity at the end of the game and disconnect your opponents. Are you ready?

apps.name: The Winner 2 - The Reality Show
apps.short_description: Experience what it's like to participate in a reality show in this casual, immersive, and fun simulator! Enter a medieval castle, compete for the title of ultimate winner, and enjoy a unique experience with an original soundtrack and fun 2D graphics.

apps.name: The Wyoming Incident
apps.short_description: A Wyoming town evacuated overnight in 1982. Your car is dead. The TV is on. Hold onto your sanity while the broadcast gets inside your head, dive into corrupted TVs to silence the towers, and find six keys to get out. Psychological horror with six endings, inspired by the infamous creepypasta.

apps.name: The Yield
apps.short_description: A minimalistic dystopian inspector simulator. Inspect packages, verify data, and log violations on your work sheet. Every mistake or delay brings you closer to a shift failure. Don't let the timer catch you off guard.

apps.name: They Came for Earth
apps.short_description: Retake humanity’s industrial cities during a massive alien invasion. Build and defend your factories to grow your army. Zoom from a citywide campaign map into specific battles and take command. Turn the invaders’ own tech against them and drive them off the Earth for good!

apps.name: Tidy Up: Street Market
apps.short_description: Tidy Up: Street Market is a cozy first-person organizing game. Over 6,000 items are piled up around an open-air market: fruit, fish, shoes, flowers, toys and more. Carry each one to the right stall, earn money, buy upgrades, and turn a messy street into a full, colorful market.

apps.name: Tinsel Tumble
apps.short_description: A cozy Holiday falling-block puzzle game. Drop pairs of elves and presents into the well, land an elf beside presents of its color to wrap the lot, and set off chain reactions. Story, Endless, 50 Challenges, Daily, an Advent calendar, and couch Versus and Battle mode for up to 4 players.

apps.name: Tiny Desktop Terrarium
apps.short_description: Tiny Desktop Terrarium is a glass world that lives on your desktop. You build it however you want, add creatures and inhabitants then watch it grow and flourish while you use your computer and go about your day. Pop in whenever you want to see how things are evolving!

apps.name: Titan Hunters
apps.short_description: Grab your friends, load the cannons, and defend your castle from giant monsters in this chaotic 1-4 player physics-based co-op game. Blast massive Titans apart piece by piece, upgrade your weapons, and try not to blow up your own base!

apps.name: Tithe
apps.short_description: Build a deathtrap arena. Raid someone else’s. Tithe is a dark-fantasy action raider where you design trap-filled gauntlets for other players to survive, then fight through theirs, and through the vaults, hideouts and ruins of Pheran, where everyone owes someone.

apps.name: Toque: Restaurant Tycoon
apps.short_description: A restaurant tycoon where you are part of the crew. Work wherever you want, in the kitchen, at the register or on the floor, build your place yourself and pick one of four restaurant types. Grow your menu with cooks who know the dishes and rise above the city's rival restaurants.

apps.name: Torchline
apps.short_description: The sun has fallen asleep. Carry the last ember of daylight in a single torch and lead a column of four east to the Tower of the Sleeping Sun. A fairy-tale, turn-based party RPG where your marching order is your formation — and whoever holds the torch decides what you see.

apps.name: TORNBLADE
apps.short_description: TORNBLADE is a dark action RPG that combines exploration of a mysterious world with brutal, challenging combat, inspired by the uncompromising spirit of classic games from the 80s and 90s and Slavic and Celtic mythology.

apps.name: Torque Trails: Beyond Limits
apps.short_description: Drive a variety of vehicles through challenging platforming tracks across diverse environments. Master precision driving, overcome dynamic obstacles, and conquer unique levels in this single-player driving adventure.

apps.name: Toss Drop Smash Smash
apps.short_description: Toss Drop Smash Smash is a physics based arcade-ish game where you play as a mischievous teenager hurling objects off rooftops to wreak havoc on the street below. It's part sandbox toy, part score chaser and more! Completely ridiculous fun!

apps.name: Touhou Reversal
apps.short_description: Unravel the truth behind her stolen power as Marisa Kirisame fights through endless bullet hell in this action hack and slash where every bullet can be turned against them.

apps.name: Touhou SukuSuku Racing
apps.short_description: Touhou Sukusuku Racing is a cute, casual racer set in Gensokyo and beyond. Speed through Touhou-inspired tracks, outplay rivals with varied items, and chase the championship. Between races, play with your Sukusuku friends at home and take photos together!

apps.name: TowerMouth I
apps.short_description: Couch co-op bullet heaven inside a tower that talks back. Two knights on one screen - or online with Remote Play Together - climb twenty floors on the clock to its mouth, then fall into endless HELL. Your weapons fire themselves: you hop walls, stack cards into absurd builds and get mocked.

apps.name: Toybox Tactics
apps.short_description: Enter a block-sized world and conquer the world by defending your towers in this colorful strategy game!

apps.name: Trails of Suebia
apps.short_description: Real-time strategy on a wild frontier: found a settlement, grow it into a fortified town and hold your ground in forests, marshes, steppes and deserts against rival factions, the dangers of the night and the weather.

apps.name: Train Goes Choo Choo
apps.short_description: A cozy train simulator set in rural Japan, with lo-fi music. Customize your journey, capture memories in Photo Mode, keep your train on your desktop with Mini Mode, or bring your Twitch chat aboard. Enjoy the view

apps.name: Trashake
apps.short_description: Trashake is a chaotic junkyard cafe simulator! Dig through piles of garbage, collect fresh trash, and feed it to eternally hungry pigeon customers. Upgrade your skills, expand your territory, and unlock new dumpster delicacies. Become the King of the Dump!

apps.name: Trouble Party
apps.short_description: Everything’s going great: you’ve got a nasty case of diarrhea, angry grandmas are on the attack, the poop has escaped, and your friend is pretending to be a bucket. Gather up to 8 players, unleash some chaos, and survive 16 unique game modes. And, by the way—don’t trust the bucket.

apps.name: Tutsak
apps.short_description: Tutsak is a 1–4 player co-op horror game where you complete objectives and escape before the creature catches you. Caught? You're locked in a cell until your friends break you out. Sometimes, you can sell out a teammate instead.

apps.name: Unaccounted
apps.short_description: Unaccounted is a first-person murder mystery set in the 1980s Eastern Bloc. Explore an apartment building in this whodunit built on classic detective work. Find out who its residents are and what each did on the night of the fire, then name the arsonist.

apps.name: Undercrown: Protect the Deadland
apps.short_description: Dig a living dungeon, grow a hungry ecosystem of monsters and hide the Dungeon Lord from waves of human heroes. Thirty years after losing the throne, Albert returns - and this time the arena is underground.

apps.name: Undersea: Waves and Adventures
apps.short_description: You are the captain of a submarine of a small Ukrainian island state, with a big baggage of dreams and a lot of problems. Sink enemy ships, explore mysterious abandoned bases, steal secret documents. Drink tea and don't forget to have fun. Your team is already waiting for you. To the Battle!

apps.name: Undying Soul
apps.short_description: Undying Soul is a 2D action roguelite focused on fluid combat, character swapping, and broken build crafting. Choose your allies, combine their abilities, discover powerful synergies and adapt your playstyle to overcome deadly foes and reclaim your shattered soul.

apps.name: Unextinct
apps.short_description: A post-apocalyptic online evolution game. Wake up as a cloned microbe at the bottom of a drowned world and evolve into a virus, a predator or something new. 180+ evolution paths, 90+ locations, riddle quests and real-time PvP with other players.

apps.name: Universal Chess
apps.short_description: A standalone chess system on an 8×8 board. King and Queen with equal or alternating sovereign powers, new heavy pieces, 192 symmetrical setups, diarchic or monarchical regimes and standard or enhanced movement. Martial Rule and Atomic Permutation. Play vs. AI, 2P on one PC, or AI vs. AI.

apps.name: Unstable Launch
apps.short_description: A rage game about thrusting through rings and dodging moving hazards to maintain trajectory. Play solo or co-op, with each player controlling two thrusters. You’ll crash, go off course, and lose your mind.

apps.name: Untangle The Internet
apps.short_description: Every cable in the world lies in one huge pile on the floor of a data center. Pull cables out, carry each plug to its port and watch the cable snap into a neat run. Restore the internet alone or in online co-op with up to 5 friends.

apps.name: Unwell
apps.short_description: Descend into your own broken mind in this psychological survival horror. Survive twisted manifestations of your psyche, defend your shelter, and shape your fate through choices that lead to multiple endings.

apps.name: Upbaka!
apps.short_description: Charge your way through enemies and become a little bit.. VERY overpowered, because here violence is the answer. Grab loot, level up, get to higher and higher floors,  and hope you make a good build...

apps.name: Urban Echoes
apps.short_description: Urban Echoes is a relaxing skateboarding game demo with stylish retro graphics that encourages exploration, individuality, and self-discovery.

apps.name: Us Against Wood
apps.short_description: Us Against Wood is a co-op casual game where you and your friends share one simple goal: chop down a single enormous tree. Work together or alone to carve deeper into the trunk.

apps.name: Utopia '97
apps.short_description: A twin-stick shooter set in a perfect world with no conflict and no bad guys. Blow kisses at your friends and teleport them to a happy-go-lucky carnival for the day.

apps.name: V TUBER MANAGEMENT
apps.short_description:
This is a talent development simulation game where you choose one of three unique V Tubers to manage.
Take on the role of a manager and plan their activity schedules.
Don’t just focus on boosting their stats—take care of their physical and mental well-being to guide them to becoming top streamers!

apps.name: Velvet Rope: Nightlife Manager
apps.short_description: Manage your own nightclub in this 2D management sim. Hire staff, set prices, handle troublesome guests, upgrade your venues and keep the party running while turning each night into a profitable business.

apps.name: Victory's Grave: Death Before Dismount
apps.short_description: Top-down arcade tank shooter. Plant mines, battle Soviet armor, and defend your flag in a destructible Eastern European city.

apps.name: Videogame Automation Engineer
apps.short_description: In this visual programming game, you become a video game tester for different clients. Using intuitive image sensors and logic wiring, you automate a vast collection of minigames to make your circuit press the right virtual gamepad buttons at the right time.

apps.name: Vivian Wade: Danger Down The Aisle
apps.short_description: The night before the wedding, the altar burns down and the wedding planner is injured. The family blames a curse, but she suspects foul play. Play as a college student who goes undercover as her replacement. Can you solve the mystery before the wedding?

apps.name: Void Balls
apps.short_description: A two-button roguelite bullet hell. Parry enemies to steal their power, evolve with 15 upgrade cards, and face the Mjolnir boss. ~10 minute runs. Simple to learn. Hard to master. Every run is different.

apps.name: Void Chain
apps.short_description: Swap panels, match three or more, and trigger chain reactions before the rising stack hits the top. Void Chain is a fast, colorful puzzle game set against a drifting cosmos, where every clear buys you a breath and every combo pushes you deeper into the void.

apps.name: VOXHELL
apps.short_description: You are the subject. He is the experiment. Forty-eight rooms of traps designed to test not your reflexes, but your behavior, while a smug narrator comments on every mistake. And when you need a break, there's a whole other game waiting on the computer.

apps.name: VPet Sort Together: Cozy Tidy Up
apps.short_description: A cozy organizing sim for 1–4 players: sort 9,600+ virtual pet toys — egg keychains, boxed pets, watches, rings and more — onto the shelves of a pastel VPet shop. Toss, stack and tidy up the chaos together, unlock skills and perks, no timer.

apps.name: Wallstrike
apps.short_description: Compete with up to 8 players in a fast-paced ball sport where every rally is about choosing your position, timing your strike and putting the ball out of the next player's reach. Outplay the competition and become the best wallstriker in the world!

apps.name: WAND
apps.short_description: WAND is a first-person survival game. Matches are timed: grab loot, score points, and stop the others doing it first. They shoot back. The weather roots for nobody and throws people, tears the ground, and drops lightning. Solo works. You are the only one shooting, and the weather still hits you.

apps.name: Wanderer Wheels
apps.short_description: Take a relaxing road trip home in your van, turning it into a mobile shop to trade goods along the way. Explore scenic roads, visit small towns, eat, refuel, and camp as you travel. Trade and earn enough money to pay for your wife's treatment before you reach home.

apps.name: WARD/EN
apps.short_description: You run the ship. The drone runs itself. Write directives in a real programming language, debug them on a test bench, and dispatch autonomous drones into derelict wrecks. You never steer them live. Read what comes back, and write a better plan.

apps.name: Warden Tycoon
apps.short_description: Build a prison from an empty plot into a four-level giant, then run it. A thousand inmates each have needs, moods, friends and grudges. Feed them, keep them busy and watch them closely, or they will fight, riot, smuggle, dig and climb their way out.

apps.name: Warelings
apps.short_description: A tiny 2000s gadget that lives in the corner of your desktop. Feed your Ware, take it on walks and send it into battle while you work. Every creature is a post from an internet forum that no longer exists.

apps.name: Warlords Battlecry: The Protectors of Etheria
apps.short_description: A hero in a world of real time strategy - command armies, build your empire, become savior or conqueror. With over 50 factions and a hero that never stops growing, no two campaigns are ever the same in this dark fantasy RTS+RPG universe forged over thirty years of Warlords history.

apps.name: Warrior Is Just Going
apps.short_description: There is no retreat. It is a game that tells the story of a mysterious journey of a warrior who only moves forward.

apps.name: Ways Unknown
apps.short_description: Piece together ancient secrets hidden in plain sight in this surreal open-world mystery set in a strange desert.

apps.name: When Ren Ran
apps.short_description: A morning jog turned Ren into a spirit. To regain his human form, he'll have to negotiate with the local spirits — each with their own conditions. A fairy-tale point-and-click puzzle game, hand-drawn.

apps.name: White Bloom
apps.short_description: A story-driven survival horror RPG where you explore an underground research facility as "Eira". Solve puzzles, survive deadly creatures, and uncover the truth behind the events that led you here.

apps.name: Whitopia
apps.short_description: Experience pure calm through a short relaxing 3D painting simulation. Cover graffiti, clutter, and anything colorful in pure white. Earn rewards, unlock upgrades, and become more efficient as you restore a world where white is the only color allowed to exist.

apps.name: Whodunit Sudoku
apps.short_description: This is a logic puzzle blending Sudoku with murder mystery deduction. Place suspects using row-and-column rules on illustrated crime scenes, then read spatial clues and room boundaries to deduce who was left alone with the victim. Pure logic, no guessing.

apps.name: Wholesaler Simulator
apps.short_description: Build your own wholesale business in Wholesaler Simulator! Negotiate with producers, stock products in your warehouse, and fulfill online orders. Upgrade your warehouse, hire workers, and buy new vehicles. Manage deliveries and grow your business in this realistic trading simulation!

apps.name: Why Not Fly That?
apps.short_description: Strap thrusters to shopping carts, fridges, and everyday objects in this single-player physics sandbox. Build your own flying machine, assign its controls, and fly, tumble, and tackle obstacles. Experiment with each design and see how far it goes.

apps.name: Wiggle Racing
apps.short_description: Drift, race, survive.  Hit the corners, master the drift, and chase the perfect run. Push your limits in a fast-paced racing experience where every turn is an opportunity to show off your skills with a car equipped with a grappling hook.

apps.name: Wilderload
apps.short_description: Monsters everywhere. Bounties everywhere. A retro pixel-art wasteland tank RPG: dig your first tank out from under an old freight depot, read the wanted posters, rebuild the thing part by part, and go collect with two partners and a dog. Where you go and who you flatten first is your call.

apps.name: WildScore
apps.short_description: Take coins, buy animal cards, and race to the winning score. WildScore is a turn-based tabletop game in a sunlit courtyard. Play solo against bots, pass-and-play locally, or invite a friend on Steam. Up to four players.

apps.name: Wildsite
apps.short_description: Crash-land in a sci-fi survival craft game set on a planet plagued by toxic plasma storms. Alongside Bob, your sarcastic Virtual Sidekick, build and shrink your base to move it anywhere. Fight with primitive or plasma weapons, solo or with up to 3 friends in online co-op!

apps.name: Wolf Commando
apps.short_description: An explosive 80s-inspired top-down military shooter where skill, guts, and firepower decide everything. Choose your route and fight for the highest score.

apps.name: WonderPaws
apps.short_description: Welcome to WonderPaws! Where a city is built by animals! Here Paw Pals run shops, make friends, and chase their dreams. You, a newly arrived human, get a whimsical new life: share a home with Paw Pals, decorate it, become a star, mayor, or designer… or turn into a Paw Pal yourself and try it all!

apps.name: Wool Shop
apps.short_description: A cozy idle game that lives along the edge of your screen. Your sheep graze, their wool is spun and knitted, and customers shop at your little store while you work. Your sheepdog follows your cursor and helps herd the flock.

apps.name: World 23
apps.short_description: World 23 is a fast-paced, top-down action game built exclusively for two-player co-op. Fight through ruined cities, dark metro tunnels, and enemy bases. Combine your skills with a friend to trigger powerful effects and control the battlefield together.

apps.name: World Craft Dream Island
apps.short_description: Build your dream island block by block – alone or with up to 10 friends online! A cozy voxel sandbox where you mine, craft and survive the night, raise 46 ready-made buildings, tame talking pets and open portals to realms ruled by bosses.

apps.name: Wrathbreaker
apps.short_description: You are the Wrathbreaker, a powerful spellcasting warrior lord. Gather your forces and embark on an epic campaign against the hordes of evil in this classic dark fantasy action-adventure.

apps.name: XANNIBAN
apps.short_description: Point and click to trap machines in this action-horror shooter. Plan, lure, and adapt to survive beneath.

apps.name: YBR-You Break Rock
apps.short_description: A first person game where you play as an ant. Move rocks, experiment with your rocks and explore at your own pace. A short experience focused on interaction, discovery and simple fun.

apps.name: You Got Me Killed!
apps.short_description: Two players share one body: one controls the legs, the other the arms. Survive endless monster hordes, evolve your skills, summon bosses and blame each other for every death in this co-op roguelite bullet heaven.

apps.name: You Said Last Wave
apps.short_description: “Didn't you say this was the last wave?” The guns are still firing as another horde scales the wall. Auto-battling meets tower defense: combine machine guns, shotguns, fire, and chain lightning while your soldiers fight on their own. Can your setup hold until the last wave?

apps.name: YOUR DEAD WEIGHT
apps.short_description: Asymmetric co-op horror-comedy for up to 6 players. Move the furniture out before time runs out, or become the thing that won't let it leave.

apps.name: Your Suffering Is Important to Us
apps.short_description: Run a corporate office in Hell. Hire, customize, and assign imployees, reject petty sinners, automate absurd punishments, and climb the infernal corporate ladder in this comedic incremental management game.

apps.name: YoYo Blade
apps.short_description: Master a tethered blade in a mouse-only incremental action game. Throw it, build up speed, and upgrade it to fight back waves of enemies before corruption consumes your world.

apps.name: Zip Up
apps.short_description: As a stylist working for Hollywood's biggest celebrities, dress up your troublesome clients for their showbiz events and somehow manage a romance with a celebrity in this story-driven dress up game inspired by reality TV & Hollywood culture

apps.name: Zombies & Battery
apps.short_description: Zombies hunt by the sound of your heartbeat, and only static from a government radio can hide it. Keep the battery alive, drive your camper van to the safe zone, and scavenge, sneak and revive fallen friends in casual co-op zombie survival for 1–4 players.

apps.name: [Hell is Empty]
apps.short_description:
The Playground beckons you. Play as Dreadnaught: A hulking monstrosity meant to destroy everything in his path. But when he finds a damaged robot named Miss Sunshine...something within him snaps. And now Miss Sunshine might be the only one who's safe.
[A Visual Novel]

apps.name: ‌Super Puzzle‌
apps.short_description: A feature-packed casual jigsaw puzzle game! Enjoy multiple difficulties, real-time multiplayer battles, Workshop custom images, desktop pets, rhythm mini-games, and story mode. 9 languages, 22 Steam achievements!

apps.name: かぼちゃのトロワ
apps.short_description:
Take control of Torowa the pumpkin and challenge all 40 stages!
Stomp on monsters to defeat them, collect candies, and aim for a high score by defeating monsters in the specified order during Night Mode!

apps.name: ねこっとラーメン
apps.short_description: 異世界に転生したあなたが得たスキルは「カップラーメンを出す」！？猫の獣人たちが暮らす世界で出会った女の子・ユズと、成り行きで始めたお店を営業する調理シミュレーション。注文に合う商品を選び、かやくやスープを入れ、お湯の量と待ち時間を見極めて一杯を仕上げましょう。複数のお客さんを同時に迎え、それぞれの調理時間と待ち時間を管理。日ごとに変わる注文傾向や制限を乗り越えた先で、物語は複数の結末へ分岐します。

apps.name: ねこ天下～三国志パチンコタイピングで轟かす～
カエルvsヒツジ娘
apps.short_description: A mini 3D action game where you fight a giant sheep girl

apps.name: ソラの教室 : Classroom in Sora
apps.short_description: A laid-back sci-fi adventure about making friends at a school in space (Sora). You play a friend-seeking, space-born human at a new school full of alien students of every species. Talk to everyone—grow close or drift apart—and uncover the mystery hidden within the school.

apps.name: ダイノボックス
apps.short_description:
Drop dinosaurs,merge matching species, and evolve them into something bigger!
DinoBox is a physics-based puzzle game where every 20 turns, a meteor strikes the box—destroying one dinosaur and potentially changing everything. Build bigger dinos, fill your encyclopedia, and see how far you can evolve!

apps.name: ピギーワン SUPER SPARK
apps.short_description: PIGGY ONE SUPER SPARK is a single-player action game starring Xiamy, Yuez, and a lost newborn baby they happen to find. Follow the trio in their chaotic but heart-warming adventure!

apps.name: プールサイドの記憶
apps.short_description: A first-person chase horror set in endless liminal poolrooms. Scattered memories, multiple endings — and a world that rebuilds itself into a new nightmare every run.

apps.name: 仙途有约
apps.short_description: <仙途有约>是一款MMORPG动作仙侠游戏巨作，游戏拥有唯美的场景，精良的画面，悠长的故事，难尽的情缘。海市楼台，雾漫灵山，完美诠释国风神韵。宏大背景，曲折剧情，凄美再现仙侠长歌。

apps.name: 你的“那个”
apps.short_description:
Finally, you can grow your own little thing.

Water it, feed it, and experiment with your technique to shape how it grows. Every mushroom has its own size, patterns, and quirks. It lives right on your desktop, reacts to your touch, and sometimes gets up to mischief.

How big will yours get?

apps.name: 坤坤商店大整理
apps.short_description: An organizing game made exclusively for IKUNs! After a chaotic "Sing, Dance, Rap" incident, 3400 KunKun figures are scattered everywhere. Sort all 30 types back onto their shelves, earn rewards, and unlock new skills. No timers, no quotas—pure relaxing fun!

apps.name: 她的小女巫
apps.short_description: A cozy yuri visual novel with dual perspectives, choices, and multiple endings! An otherworldly witch ends up living with a socially anxious manga artist. Through misunderstandings, unspoken feelings, and ordinary days, two very different girls slowly become part of each other's lives.

apps.name: 山河念远
apps.short_description: 民国十三年，顾念之为摆脱包办婚姻孤身南下。她以为逃离牢笼便能获得自由，可等待她的，是码头的骗局、工厂女工的血泪、军阀混战的硝烟，以及三个截然不同的男人……可在这山河破碎的年代，当一个女人想要主宰自己的命运时，她要付出什么样的代价？

apps.name: 巡查員：異常報告
apps.short_description: Memorize things and look for anomalies, but you have to keep walking around in the scene. At the end of a level, there will even be a huge monster chasing you, and by the time you finish a level, half your fingers will be sore.

apps.name: 我在宗门寻长生
apps.short_description: Begin anew each season in a cultivation RPG. Join four sects, master techniques, battle bosses, explore secret realms, grow herbs, craft treasures, raise spirit pets, and trade with players. Levels and gear reset, while pets, cosmetics, tokens, and titles carry over.

apps.name: 方块战舰: Module Warship
apps.short_description: In 方块战舰：Module Warship, you command the fleet and design the ships.This 2D space sandbox rejects pre-set hulls, offering extreme DIY freedom instead. Assemble dozens of functional modules to craft your ultimate warship from scratch, then lead your custom fleet to conquer the unknown depths of space.

apps.name: 星河仙道 Immortal Path
apps.short_description: this is a systemic, 2D open-world sandbox Cultivation (Xianxia) game. Beyond static scripts, you’ll inhabit a living universe where everything is interactive and evolving in real-time. Experience alchemy, beast taming, and flight, while truly reshaping a dynamic world driven by a chain of causality.

apps.name: 星萌EV
apps.short_description: A chibi sci-fi mecha collection in one single-player package: a 4-chapter story campaign, real-time strategy Conquest, 24-level tower defense, the bullet-heaven roguelite Star Drift, and the leaderboard survival mode Endless Deep. Fight on foot, board your mech, and crush the swarm.

apps.name: 永夜无期：光圈2号 Evernight Imperative: Iris 2
apps.short_description: Evernight Imperative: Iris 2 is a free short-form sci-fi visual novel set in a far-future spacefaring civilization. Follow the crew, uncovering the truth behind unfolding events while navigating shifting relationships, conflicting perspectives, and difficult choices.

apps.name: 猛鬼搬家公司
apps.short_description: Haunted Movers is a 1–4 player online co-op physics comedy about hauling possessed furniture that fights back. Grab, lift, squeeze through tight spaces, survive paranormal chaos, and get everything onto the truck—preferably without destroying the client's house.

apps.name: 看远处 Look Far
apps.short_description: A narrative adventure that begins inside a star. You are a carbon atom, born alongside a beam of light. Your paths part. Drift through oceans and forests, and into a human life. Six and a half billion years pass for you. For the light, not a second.

apps.name: 義妹生活 Days with My Lo-Fi Sister
apps.short_description: Days with My Lo-Fi Sister is a productivity adventure with Saki Ayase. Study, work, or relax with lo-fi music and the anime's soundtrack. Customize your workspace, chat, or rest beside Saki. Time spent working unlocks original stories written for the game by series author Ghost Mikawa.

apps.name: 荷莱Horae
apps.short_description: 或许，这是你见过最自私的故事。

apps.name: 菌群觉醒：开端
apps.short_description: A 2D sci-fi mystery puzzle adventure. Search for your missing sister in a research facility overrun by strange microbial life. Deconstruct living barriers, reshape adaptable growths into functional organs, and reveal hidden connections to solve puzzles by learning how the colony works.

apps.name: 野棋
apps.short_description: Wild Chess is a 1v1 online turn-based tactical board game. On a hex battlefield you spend energy to spawn, move and attack, then evolve your pieces into 20 specialized forms such as ghosts, cannons and ice mages. Online matches only. Simplified Chinese interface.

apps.name: 问道九州
apps.short_description: A pixel-art xianxia RPG. Cultivate from Qi Refining to Tribulation, master 200 skills and 72 arts, fly on your sword across ten regions, then found your own sect: raise buildings, train disciples, and defend your mountain gate against rival powers.

apps.name: Blue Fire Soundtrack
apps.short_description:
From award-winning composer Ariel Contreras-Esquivel, comes the original soundtrack for Blue Fire by Robi Studios and Graffiti Games.

This album contains 16 tracks from the game, in full HD quality.

apps.name: Breadcrumbs: Still Here Soundtrack
apps.short_description: Original soundtrack for video game Breadcrumbs: Still Here

apps.name: Clustertruck OST
apps.short_description: Support indie composers by buying the official Clustertruck OST, featuring 13 trucks from the infamous truck-jumping platformer

apps.name: DAVE THE DIVER Original Soundtrack
apps.short_description: Dive back into the Blue Hole with the official DAVE THE DIVER Original Soundtrack. Relive every unforgettable moment, from peaceful underwater exploration to late-night sushi bar rushes and wild adventures. Bring Dave's journey and atmosphere wherever you go.

apps.name: Deadline Soundtrack
apps.short_description: The music in Deadline is designed to completely pull you into its world. From haunting, atmospheric soundscapes that underscore your exploration to pulse-pounding tracks during intense encounters, every piece of audio is crafted to elevate the emotional weight of your journey.

apps.name: DESIRO. Soundtrack
apps.short_description: DESIR⏺. Soundtrack

apps.name: Grim Dawn Soundtrack
apps.short_description: Immerse yourself in nearly 5 hours of epic music from the apocalyptic world of Cairn with 62 tracks from Grim Dawn and its two expansions, Ashes of Malmouth and Forgotten Gods.

apps.name: Lover OST四季篇
apps.short_description: 《Lover》原声带收录——四季主题——，共31首曲目。

apps.name: Metal Swarm Infinity Soundtrack
apps.short_description: Each of the Metal Swarm Infinity boss battle soundtracks exported as full length, high quality MP3s.

apps.name: MOLE Soundtrack
apps.short_description: This is additional content for MOLE, but does not include the base game.

apps.name: Oh My Girl / 我的女孩 Soundtrack
apps.short_description: Soundtracks from Oh, My Girl

apps.name: OneShot: Fading Memory Soundtrack
apps.short_description: The soundtrack for OneShot: Fading Memory.

apps.name: Planet Nine Original Soundtrack
apps.short_description: Experience the beauty, mystery, and gentle weightlessness of space with the original soundtrack to Planet Nine, a planet-merging puzzle game. Let the music bring a little of its universe into your workday or moments of relaxation.

apps.name: RADIOSOL Original Soundtrack
apps.short_description: The original soundtrack of RADIOSOL, featuring music composed and produced by Yodez.

apps.name: Soulstonia - Original Soundtrack
apps.short_description: Experience the music of Soulstonia outside the game with the complete Original Soundtrack, composed, recorded, and produced by Shawn Patrick Campbell.

apps.name: Stardust Galaxy Warriors - Strike Update Soundtrack
apps.short_description: Boss music tracks from Stardust Galaxy Warriors: Stellar Climax Strike Update!

apps.name: State of Decay: Original Game Soundtrack
apps.short_description: This companion to the 2013 hit game State of Decay contains 21 tracks of original game music by award-winning composer Jesper Kyd and Undead Labs audio director Kevin Patzelt.

apps.name: State of Decay: Year-One Survival Edition Soundtrack
apps.short_description: The official Year-One Survival Edition soundtrack is a companion to the original game soundtrack and contains 17 additional tracks of game music by award-winning composer Jesper Kyd.

apps.name: The Dota 2 Remixes EP
apps.short_description: A Remix EP of songs from DOTA 2.

apps.name: 逐光之旅 Lumione Soundtrack
apps.short_description: The Lumione Game Soundtrack has officially been released! The soundtrack album includes 32 pieces of original background music used in the game. Our carefully crafted songs will allow players to embark on their very own deep-sea adventure no matter where they may be.

apps.name: Skyrim Special Edition: Creation Kit
apps.short_description: The Creation Kit is a free downloadable editor that allows you to create mods for Skyrim and then share them with other players across Bethesda.net.

apps.name: Behind The Schemes: Swords of Ditto (onebitbeyond)
apps.short_description:
Hang out with Bidds and Sam in sunny London, and explore the multi-colored corners of their brains that gave birth to The Swords of Ditto.

Special cameo appearance from Francois, the creator of Reigns.

Plus bonus coffee, Kuffs, and conkers.

apps.name: BFG Unlocked Against All Odds: BFG Unlocked Against All Odds – Fade to Silence Docmentary
apps.short_description: Black Forest Games is about to release their new game on Early Access. There is only one slot left and time is running out. But then unexpected problems occur. Join the development team of BFG on their journey from the game's announcement until the first updates of 'Fade to Silence'.

apps.name: Escalation: Breach The Fortress
apps.short_description: Escalation : Breach The Fortress

apps.name: Escalation: Stay On Top
apps.short_description: Escalation : Stay On Top

apps.name: The Making of Horizon Zero Dawn: Mathijs De Jonge Extended Interview
apps.short_description: In this extended cut of our interview with Horizon Zero Dawn's Director Mathijs De Jonge, we talk about the long process of crafting the game from initial pitch to boxed release.
